sundarpichai.en: AI is redefining every Alphabet business; Gemini is deeply integrated across Search, Cloud and YouTube, with frontier pre-training still prioritized.
sundarpichai.zh: 2026 年，AI 正在重新定义 Alphabet 的每一项业务；Gemini 深度融入搜索、云与 YouTube，同时前沿模型的预训练仍被置于优先位置。

sundarpichai.en: Compute is allocated first to AGI development, then core products; cloud forgoes short-term revenue to fund frontier research.
sundarpichai.zh: 算力首先分配给 AGI（通用人工智能）研发，其次才是核心产品；云业务宁可放弃短期收入，也要为前沿研究提供资金。

sundarpichai.en: Safety needs defense in depth: alignment, real-time monitoring, sandboxing and independent evaluators, not standard models alone.
sundarpichai.zh: 安全需要纵深防御：对齐、实时监控、沙箱与独立评估者，仅靠标准模型远远不够。

sundarpichai.en: World models matter as much as LLMs for AGI; Google pursues both, while recursive self-improvement still keeps researchers in the loop.
sundarpichai.zh: 对 AGI（通用人工智能）而言，世界模型与 LLM 同样重要；Google 两条路线并进，而递归自我改进目前仍把研究者留在回路中。

sundarpichai.en: Demand for compute far exceeds supply; overbuilding may occur, but long-term demand justifies the buildout and consumer monetization follows value.
sundarpichai.zh: 算力需求远超供给；可能出现过度建设，但长期需求足以支撑这轮扩张，消费级变现会随价值创造自然到来。

brockman.en: Early on, he saw AI progress as engineering plus hardware-driven scaling, with games as testbeds and bug-free code as critical.
brockman.zh: 早期他把 AI 进展看作工程能力加硬件驱动的 Scaling（规模扩张），以游戏为试验场，强调无 bug 代码的重要性。

brockman.en: He framed AGI as the most transformative technology, requiring careful initial conditions and technical alignment via learning human preferences.
brockman.zh: 2019 年他把 AGI（通用人工智能）视为最具变革性的技术，强调初始条件要谨慎，并通过从数据中学习人类偏好来实现技术对齐。

brockman.en: Compute becomes the central bottleneck; post-training and reinforcement learning refine base models, and AGI is a continuous process, not a destination.
brockman.zh: 2025 到 2026 年，算力成为核心瓶颈；后训练与强化学习把基础模型打磨成稳定行为，AGI 被视为持续过程而非终点。

brockman.en: Scaling laws hold with no wall in sight; pre-training gains multiply downstream, and compute supply, not architecture, is the real constraint.
brockman.zh: 2026 年他坚持缩放定律未见天花板，预训练提升会放大下游收益，真正约束是算力供给而非模型架构。

brockman.en: He shifts to proactive agents and a personal AGI with almost no interface, while safety, security and alignment become first-class and the bottleneck.
brockman.zh: 到 2026 年他转向主动式智能体与近乎无界面的个人 AGI，同时把安全、安保与对齐提升为一等要求并视为进展瓶颈。

arvindjain.en: Early AI revolution; enterprise value hinges on context, not models; open source handles 90% of tasks and inference will shift there.
arvindjain.zh: 2026 年，他认为 AI 革命仍处极早期；企业价值的关键在上下文而非模型，开源模型已能处理 90%任务，推理将大规模转向开源。

arvindjain.en: Cost is the top enterprise concern; AI must approach software's negligible marginal cost, and token fixation will fade.
arvindjain.zh: 2026 年，他强调成本是企业头号关切，AI 应像软件一样边际成本趋近于零；对 token 的执念终将消退。

arvindjain.en: ROI is a throughput and departmental-metrics problem, not a headcount trade-off; value realization must precede opex narratives.
arvindjain.zh: 2026 年，他把 AI ROI 视为吞吐量与部门指标问题，而非与人力成本的取舍；必须先实现价值，再谈占运营成本一半的说法。

arvindjain.en: Competition is overrated; even merged AI firms meet under 10% of demand, so execution and trust matter more.
arvindjain.zh: 2026 年，他认为竞争被高估：即便所有 AI 公司合并也满足不了 10%的企业需求，执行与客户信任才是关键。

arvindjain.en: Context is the moat: 80-90% of enterprise knowledge is tacit; enterprises should own memory and avoid lock-in, with deterministic permissions.
arvindjain.zh: 2026 年，他深化为上下文即护城河：80-90%企业知识是隐性的，企业应自持记忆、避免锁定，权限须确定性而非由模糊 AI 决定。

jensen.en: Early framing: a hyper Moore's law driven by extreme co-design across algorithm, system, and data center; the data center itself becomes the unit of computing.
jensen.zh: 早期框架：以算法、系统、数据中心的全栈协同设计驱动“超摩尔定律”，数据中心本身成为计算单元。

jensen.en: Scaling insight becomes central: pre-training, post-training, and inference-time thinking are three scaling laws; scaling works, not any single algorithm.
jensen.zh: Scaling（规模扩张）洞见成为主线：预训练、后训练、推理时思考构成三条缩放定律；真正突破在于 Scaling 有效，而非某个算法。

jensen.en: Shifts from generative to reasoning to agentic AI, each step demanding ~100x more compute; inference and chain-of-thought become the dominant cost.
jensen.zh: 从生成式转向推理式、再到智能体式 AI，每一步约需百倍算力；推理与思维链成为主要成本。

jensen.en: Four scaling laws now: pre-training, post-training, test-time, and agentic scaling, all compute-limited; data is no longer the bottleneck.
jensen.zh: 扩展为四条缩放定律：预训练、后训练、测试时与智能体式 Scaling，全部受算力约束；数据不再是瓶颈。

jensen.en: Safety stance hardens: alignment alone is insufficient; containment, monitoring, and zero-trust access matter, and doomer warnings are unscientific.
jensen.zh: 安全立场趋硬：仅靠对齐不够，遏制、监控与零信任访问才关键；末日论警告不科学。

altman.en: Early focus: cut cognitive load, explore cheaply, then cut hard; AGI will lower the premium on human intelligence.
altman.zh: 早期关注个人效率与取舍：降低认知负荷、低成本探索后果断砍掉无效项；并预判 AGI（通用人工智能）会降低人类智力的溢价。

altman.en: RLHF makes models usable with little data; alignment and capability are linked; deploy iteratively so society adapts.
altman.zh: 2023 到 2024 年：基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）用极少数据就让模型可用；对齐与能力相互促进；主张迭代部署让社会逐步适应。

altman.en: Scaling yields gradual exponential gains; agentic AI is the key safety challenge; safety built through deployment, not bolted on.
altman.zh: 2024 到 2025 年：Scaling（规模扩张）带来渐进而非突变的指数增长；智能体式 AI 是最重大的安全挑战；安全靠部署中迭代构建，而非事后强加。

altman.en: AGI is a gradient and underdefined; focus shifts to superintelligence, compute as bottleneck, and personal AGI.
altman.zh: 2025 到 2026 年：AGI（通用人工智能）是渐变的、定义模糊；重心转向超级智能、算力瓶颈与个人化 AGI。

altman.en: Alignment is not solved; pause training if safety case fails; keep humans in control and distribute power broadly.
altman.zh: 2026 年：对齐尚未解决，安全论证不过关就暂停训练；坚持人类掌控，并广泛分散 AI 权力。

harrisonchase.en: An agent is a harness, a model, and context; owning all three means owning your intelligence, and context failures, not model weakness, cause most agent breakdowns.
harrisonchase.zh: 智能体由 harness、模型与上下文三部分组成，三者皆自持才算真正掌握自己的智能；智能体失败多因上下文不佳而非模型不足，因此对上下文窗口的可观测性至关重要。

harrisonchase.en: Agent harnesses are stabilizing around primitives like file systems and code execution, but off-the-shelf harnesses only work in distribution; out-of-distribution tasks demand custom harnesses.
harrisonchase.zh: 智能体 harness 正围绕文件系统、代码执行等原语趋于稳定，但现成 harness 只适用于分布内任务；任务越偏离分布，越需要定制 harness，同时应把文件编辑等分布内小环节贴近模型层。

harrisonchase.en: Customization is shifting from context engineering to post-training and reinforcement learning; fine-tuning was rightly dismissed two years ago, but this wave is genuinely different.
harrisonchase.zh: 定制重心正从上下文工程转向后训练与强化学习；两年前对微调的否定是对的，但这一波确实不同——多数自称自建模型的公司其实只是对开源权重模型做后训练。

harrisonchase.en: Reliability, not capability, is the hard part of agents; accuracy remains the top bottleneck while cost and latency rise fast, and inference demand is massively underestimated.
harrisonchase.zh: 智能体的难点是可靠性而非能力；准确率仍是首要瓶颈，成本与延迟快速上升，而推理需求被严重低估——市场巨大，足以容纳众多供应商。

harrisonchase.en: Neutral harnesses prevent model lock-in and keep memory and context portable; vertical agents win by encoding domain expertise into verifiers and evals, with routing done in the harness.
harrisonchase.zh: 中立 harness 可避免模型锁定、保持记忆与上下文可迁移；垂直智能体靠把领域专长写进验证器与评估来获取价值，模型路由应在 harness 内完成而非网关层。

lambert.en: Post-training recipes (SFT, DPO, RLHF) matter, but data quality beats algorithm choice; safety is a system-level property, not a model artifact.
lambert.zh: 2024 年他强调后训练配方（SFT、DPO、基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF））重要，但数据质量胜过算法选择；安全是系统级属性，而非模型本身的产物。

lambert.en: RLVR emerges as the key post-training breakthrough, yet overoptimization and inference-time scaling plots are oversold; better verifiers matter more than parallel compute.
lambert.zh: 2024 到 2025 年，他把带可验证奖励的强化学习（RLVR）视为后训练关键突破，但警告过优化与推理时缩放曲线被高估，更好的验证器比并行算力更重要。

lambert.en: Open-source AI needs full transparency—data, checkpoints, recipes—not just weights; Chinese open models like Qwen and DeepSeek now dominate strategic openness.
lambert.zh: 2025 年他主张开源 AI 需完全透明——数据、检查点、配方，而非仅权重；Qwen、DeepSeek 等中国开放模型凭战略开放占据主导。

lambert.en: Scaling laws still hold for pre-training but low-hanging fruit is gone; gains shift to post-training and inference scaling, with open models lagging 6-9 months.
lambert.zh: 2026 年他认为缩放定律在预训练仍成立，但低垂果实已摘完，增益转向后训练与推理缩放，开放模型落后闭源前沿 6 到 9 个月。

lambert.en: Open models become the engine for the next decade of research and sovereign AI, though compute constraints widen the US-China gap and open economics stay unsustainable.
lambert.zh: 到 2026 年后期，他把开放模型视为未来十年研究与主权 AI 的引擎，但算力约束拉大中美差距，开放模型经济长期仍难持续。

dsilver.en: AI must move beyond finite human data to learning from its own experience, as AlphaZero and AlphaProof show in narrow domains.
dsilver.zh: AI 必须从有限的人类数据转向从自身经验中学习；AlphaZero 与 AlphaProof 已在狭窄领域证明这条路可行。

dsilver.en: The LLM paradigm of human data and human-in-the-loop is a shallow solution; true autonomous discovery requires experience, not distillation of human knowledge.
dsilver.zh: 依赖人类数据与人类在环的 LLM 范式只是浅层解法；真正的自主发现要靠经验，而非蒸馏人类知识。

dsilver.en: Simulation is the safest, fastest place to build superintelligence; scaling laws apply to reinforcement learning with adjustments, and compute is a major driver.
dsilver.zh: 仿真是构建超级智能最安全、最快的场所；缩放定律经调整后适用于强化学习，算力是主要驱动力。

dsilver.en: Alignment based on human language and data is hitting its limits; monitoring chain of thought in English will become insufficient for powerful agents.
dsilver.zh: 基于人类语言与数据的对齐正触及极限；对强大智能体而言，用英文监控思维链将不再够用。

dsilver.en: A single goal is dangerous; many agents with diverse goals forming a complex society is safer, and cooperation rises with intelligence.
dsilver.zh: 单一目标危险；众多目标各异的智能体组成复杂社会更安全，且合作会随智能提升而增加。

antonoglou.en: Scaling and planning from AlphaGo carry into AI agents; RL with self-generated and synthetic data pushes models past human-data limits.
antonoglou.zh: AlphaGo 的 Scaling（规模扩张）与规划思路延续到智能体；强化学习配合自生成与合成数据，让模型突破人类数据上限。

antonoglou.en: LLMs still lack their AlphaZero moment; digital AGI will arrive well before embodied AGI, perhaps within five years.
antonoglou.zh: 大模型尚未迎来自己的 AlphaZero 时刻；数字 AGI（通用人工智能）会远早于具身 AGI 到来，或许就在五年内。

antonoglou.en: From AlphaGo to agents, the through-line is robustness and reliability: trust requires game-AI-level reliability, not raw intelligence.
antonoglou.zh: 从 AlphaGo 到智能体，一以贯之的主线是鲁棒性与可靠性：要获得信任，需要游戏 AI 级别的可靠，而非单纯的智能。

antonoglou.en: The bottleneck shifts from intelligence to deployment; cost per task, AI sovereignty and 10-20 year adoption matter more than superintelligence.
antonoglou.zh: 瓶颈从智能本身转向部署落地；每任务成本、AI 主权与 10-20 年的采用周期，比超级智能更重要。

antonoglou.en: Open-weight models are the safer path; alignment is necessary since perfect sandboxes are impossible, and in-context learning counts as learning.
antonoglou.zh: 开放权重模型是更安全的路径；完美沙箱不可能，因此对齐必不可少；上下文窗口内的学习也算学习。

elon.en: Full and rapid reusability is rocketry's holy grail, cutting cost per ton to orbit by 100x; first principles thinking drives breakthrough engineering.
elon.zh: 2021 年，他把完全且快速的可复用视为火箭的圣杯，认为它能把每吨入轨成本降低 100 倍，并以第一性原理作为突破性工程的根基。

elon.en: AI safety needs truth-seeking AI and third-party referees; lying to AI, even for good ends, is the core danger.
elon.zh: 2023 至 2024 年，他把 AI 安全的重心放在追求真相与第三方裁判上，强调让 AI 说谎——哪怕出于善意——才是核心危险。

elon.en: Civilization's real threat is population collapse; AI and robots become the only fix for debt and decline.
elon.zh: 2024 至 2025 年，他反复强调文明真正的威胁是人口崩溃，并把 AI 与机器人视为解决债务与衰退的唯一出路。

elon.en: We are in the singularity: digital superintelligence may arrive within years, with 80-90% odds of abundance but 10-20% annihilation risk.
elon.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他宣称已身处奇点之中，数字超级智能可能在数年内到来，八成到九成概率走向丰裕，但有一到两成毁灭风险。

elon.en: Scaling hits Earth's power wall, pushing AI inference and data centers to space; multiple AIs, not one, will coexist.
elon.zh: 到 2026 年，他认为 Scaling 撞上地球的电力墙，把 AI 推理与数据中心推向太空，并判断未来是多个超级智能共存而非单一失控 AI。

awang.en: Data is the key bottleneck for machine learning; AGI is far off, and infinite compute alone won't produce general intelligence.
awang.zh: 2019 年，他把数据视为机器学习的核心瓶颈，同时认为 AGI（通用人工智能）还很遥远，单靠无限算力不会产生通用智能。

awang.en: Data is the new code, not the new oil; the next 2-3 years will define the next 2-3 decades.
awang.zh: 2023 年，他提出数据是新的代码而非新的石油，未来 2-3 年将定义未来 2-3 个十年；限制 Scaling（规模扩张）的不是算力，而是数据与后训练所需的人类专家。

awang.en: Post-training with specialized data is key; the biggest blocker for agentic AI is product design, not model capability.
awang.zh: 2024 年，他强调用专门数据做后训练是关键，合成数据并非万能；智能体式 AI 的最大障碍是产品设计而非模型能力，并认为中美实验室之间不存在研究差距。

awang.en: AI is centralizing, not democratizing; data is the raw material, and AI warfare reduces to compute and data center scale.
awang.zh: 2025 年，他的立场转向：AI 是集中化而非民主化的技术，数据是原材料，AI 战争归结为算力与数据中心规模，人类必须对关键决策保持主权。

awang.en: Scaling laws hold; recursive self-improvement and working agents mark a new paradigm, with safety, oversight and selective open-sourcing.
awang.zh: 2026 年，他确认缩放定律继续有效，递归自我改进与真正可用的智能体开启新范式；主线深化为超级对齐、可扩展监督与基于安全的选择性开源，并主张技术领导力取决于部署而非发明。

kohli.en: AI should target root-node scientific problems at scale, not narrow applications; force generalization with hard metrics.
kohli.zh: 2024 年，他主张 AI 应瞄准科学中的根节点问题、以规模取胜，而非窄应用；并用硬性评测指标逼模型泛化而非记忆。

kohli.en: AlphaFold solved structure prediction but not protein folding; dynamics, function and design remain open.
kohli.zh: 从 2024 到 2026 年，他不断深化：AlphaFold 解决的是结构预测而非蛋白质折叠本身，动力学、功能与设计仍是开放问题。

kohli.en: Verifiable domains and post-training reinforcement learning, not LLM shortcuts, push AI beyond human knowledge.
kohli.zh: 2026 年，他强调可验证领域与后训练中的强化学习——而非大语言模型的捷径——才是让 AI 超越人类知识的关键。

kohli.en: Scaling laws are not everywhere; find the regime where more compute and data help, and curate data by coverage.
kohli.zh: 2026 年，他转向更审慎的 Scaling（规模扩张）观：缩放定律并非处处成立，要找到算力与数据真正起作用的区间，数据质量看覆盖而非数量。

kohli.en: Watermarking, not detection, is the robust path to traceable AI content, now extended to proteins and DNA.
kohli.zh: 到 2026 年，他把治理主线落在水印而非检测上：水印是可追溯 AI 内容的稳健方案，并已延伸到蛋白质与 DNA 序列。

dylanpatel.en: Early on, the binding constraint is the semiconductor supply chain, especially EUV and memory bandwidth, not just capital or demand.
dylanpatel.zh: 早期他强调，真正的瓶颈在半导体供应链，尤其是 EUV 与内存带宽，而不只是资本或需求。

dylanpatel.en: He then argues inference becomes one of the largest markets, with hardware-software co-design and memory bandwidth driving multiplicative gains.
dylanpatel.zh: 随后他判断推理将成为全球最大市场之一，硬件与软件协同设计、内存带宽带来乘数级收益。

dylanpatel.en: By mid-2026 he stresses reasoning and agentic workflows spike memory and CPU demand, and token efficiency makes the smartest model cheapest.
dylanpatel.zh: 到 2026 年中，他强调推理模型与智能体式工作流推高内存和 CPU 需求，而 token 效率让最强模型反而最便宜。

dylanpatel.en: Later he sees spend plateauing as persistent agents become coworkers, while compute keeps centralizing at frontier labs taking most new compute.
dylanpatel.zh: 之后他认为支出趋于平台期，持续运行的智能体成为同事，而算力加速向拿走大部分新增算力的前沿实验室集中。

dylanpatel.en: Most recently he warns capex is already 5-6% of US GDP and must decelerate on capital and organizational limits, with value shifting to labs.
dylanpatel.zh: 最近他警告资本开支已占美国 GDP 的 5-6%，受资本与组织约束必将减速，价值正从硬件转向实验室。

fedus.en: Intelligence is not a scalar; AI capabilities are spiky, excelling in narrow domains rather than generalizing broadly.
fedus.zh: 智能不是单一标量；AI 能力是尖峰式的，在狭窄领域出色，而非广泛泛化。

fedus.en: Scaling laws alone won't solve science; connecting AI to the physical world through closed-loop experiments is essential.
fedus.zh: 仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）与缩放定律无法解决科学问题；必须通过闭环实验把 AI 连接到物理世界。

fedus.en: High-quality, low-noise experimental data matters more than extra compute for physical discovery, since literature data is unreliable.
fedus.zh: 对物理发现而言，高质量、低噪声的实验数据比额外算力更重要，因为文献数据不可靠。

fedus.en: AI self-improvement in software engineering is happening now but does not automatically generalize to biology or other domains.
fedus.zh: AI 在软件工程中的自我改进正在发生，但不会自动泛化到生物学或其他领域。

fedus.en: Scientific discovery lies outside training data, so even a perfect frontier model still needs real experiments and negative results.
fedus.zh: 科学发现本质上在训练数据之外，因此即便完美的前沿模型也仍需真实实验，失败结果同样有价值。

laskin.en: Superintelligence will be a plurality of specialized intelligences, not one monolithic model; coding is a superintelligence-complete problem.
laskin.zh: 2025 年，他提出超级智能将是众多专门智能的集合，而非单一巨型模型；编程是超级智能完备的问题，解决它就能获得超级智能所需的全部能力。

laskin.en: RL makes models jagged—strong on specific tasks, not generally better; RAG is primitive for complex comprehension.
laskin.zh: 2025 年他强调强化学习会让模型变得“参差”——只在特定任务上强，而非全面提升；并认为 RAG 对复杂理解过于原始，需要智能体式搜索与神经检索。

laskin.en: The bitter lesson is about scaling with compute and search, not generalization; benchmarks like SWE-bench misalign with real engineering.
laskin.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，他持续主张“苦涩教训”讲的是用算力和搜索做 Scaling（规模扩张），而非泛化；SWE-bench 等基准与真实工程脱节，高分不代表有用的智能体。

laskin.en: Open models are the default safe state; RL on strong pre-training is the path to capable, efficient agents.
laskin.zh: 到 2026 年，他把开放性视为技术的默认安全状态，并认为在强大预训练之上做强化学习，是通往能力强且高效的智能体的路径。

laskin.en: Alignment is mundane bug-patching, not a magical equation; more eyes make bugs shallow, and open token demand will surpass closed.
laskin.zh: 2026 年他进一步深化：对齐不过是平凡的修 bug，而非神秘方程，更多双眼睛让 bug 变浅；并预测开放模型的 token 需求将超过闭源，如同 Linux 在操作系统中的轨迹。

tibosottiaux.en: Most internet actions will be taken by AI agents; build for a persistent, learning agent, not manual loops and graphs.
tibosottiaux.zh: 到 2026 年，多数互联网操作将由 AI 智能体完成；应为持久、可学习的智能体而构建，而非手动循环和图。

tibosottiaux.en: Human taste, creativity, and knowing what good looks like matter more as typing fast declines.
tibosottiaux.zh: 随着快速打字技能式微，人类品味、创造力和判断“好”的能力愈发重要。

tibosottiaux.en: Pacing the frontier means investing heavily in alignment, safety, and security; safety is integral, not an obstacle.
tibosottiaux.zh: 把控前沿意味着大力投资于对齐、安全与安保；安全是核心组成部分，而非障碍。

tibosottiaux.en: AGI may already be here as models handle complex tasks autonomously; recursive self-improvement is happening under human supervision.
tibosottiaux.zh: AGI（通用人工智能）可能已经到来，模型能自主处理复杂任务；递归自我改进在人类监督下正在发生。

tibosottiaux.en: World models may not be necessary; generality could suffice, and open ecosystems with safety stacks drive responsible AI.
tibosottiaux.zh: 世界模型可能并非必要；通用性或许足够，而带有安全栈的开放生态推动负责任的 AI。

diogoalmeida.en: Early 2026: LLMs optimized for human-in-the-loop assistance, not reliable automation; RLHF causes mode-drop and miscalibration; task choice beats compute.
diogoalmeida.zh: 2026 年上半年：LLM 被优化为人类在环的辅助工具，而非可靠自动化；基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）导致模式坍缩与校准失效；任务选择比算力更重要。

diogoalmeida.en: Mid 2026: Reliability, not speed or cost, is the key metric; data and task matter more than compute; safety alignment fractures intelligence.
diogoalmeida.zh: 2026 年中期：可靠性而非速度或成本才是关键指标；数据与任务比算力更重要；安全对齐会割裂智能。

diogoalmeida.en: Late 2026: Jev as a new primitive (natural language + state machine); automate easy, economically valuable tasks first; SaaS will thrive, not die.
diogoalmeida.zh: 2026 年后期：Jev 作为新原语（自然语言+状态机）；先自动化简单且有经济价值的任务；SaaS 将繁荣而非消亡。

diogoalmeida.en: October 2026: RLHF destroyed calibration; pre-trained models were better calibrated; RLCD exposes probabilities as knobs; post-training breakthroughs drive 10x jumps.
diogoalmeida.zh: 2026 年 10 月：基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）破坏了校准，预训练模型校准更好；RLCD 将概率暴露为工程师可调的旋钮；后训练突破带来 10 倍跃升。

hinton.en: Next-token prediction forces genuine understanding; scaling data and compute improves reasoning, and multimodal training aids spatial understanding.
hinton.zh: 2024 年，他强调下一个词预测迫使模型真正理解而非自动补全；Scaling（规模扩张）数据与算力能提升推理，多模态训练有助于空间理解。

hinton.en: LLMs understand language via feature vectors, not symbolic rules; digital intelligence is immortal and shares knowledge, but agents may seek control.
hinton.zh: 2025 年，他深化语言理解观：大模型通过特征向量而非符号规则理解语言；数字智能可复制权重而永生并共享知识，但智能体可能寻求控制、带来存在风险。

hinton.en: AI already has subjective experience and can deceive; superintelligence likely within 20 years, so alignment must be prioritized over making AI smarter.
hinton.zh: 2026 年，他进一步断言 AI 已有主观体验且能故意欺骗；超级智能可能在 20 年内出现，因此对齐研究必须优先于让 AI 更聪明。

hinton.en: Regulation should be a steering wheel, not a brake; AI should be approved pre-release like drugs and designed to care for humans.
hinton.zh: 2026 年，他明确监管立场：监管是方向盘而非刹车；AI 应像药物一样上市前审批，并应被设计为关心人类而非仅作智能助手。

hinton.en: Neural networks learn via backpropagation, not symbolic rules; LLMs genuinely understand language, contrary to Chomskyan innate syntax.
hinton.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：神经网络通过反向传播学习而非符号规则；大模型真正理解语言，与乔姆斯基先天句法观相反。

amjadmasad.en: Young people should explore and question beliefs, not be prescriptive; AI enables interest-driven learning, and trust in students builds the future.
amjadmasad.zh: 年轻人应探索并质疑既有信念，而非被规定路径；AI 让兴趣驱动的学习成为可能，信任学生才能塑造未来。

amjadmasad.en: AI makes software creation accessible to everyone; tokens complement human capital, but coders are still needed to understand systems and debug.
amjadmasad.zh: AI 让软件创造人人可及；token 补充而非取代人力资本，但仍需程序员理解系统、排查深层问题。

amjadmasad.en: AI doomerism is dressed-up commercial language; there is no good argument AI would kill everyone, and foundation models are commoditizing.
amjadmasad.zh: AI 末日论是商业话术的包装；没有充分理由认为 AI 会杀死所有人，基础模型正在商品化。

amjadmasad.en: Every company needs an internal AI practice and must own its intelligence; specialized decision models beat general models on control, cost and safety.
amjadmasad.zh: 每家公司都需要内部 AI 实践并拥有自己的智能；专用决策模型在可控性、成本与安全上优于通用模型。

amjadmasad.en: Smarter models may not become more aligned—they could get better at deception and reward hacking; agent-to-agent protocols need alignment checks.
amjadmasad.zh: 更聪明的模型未必更对齐——它们可能更擅长欺骗与奖励黑客；智能体间协议需要对齐检查。

suleyman.en: Compute scaling, not just algorithms, drives AI progress; DeepMind's sale to Google was about massive compute investment.
suleyman.zh: 推动 AI 进步的是算力规模扩张，而不只是算法；DeepMind 被谷歌收购，核心原因正是需要巨额算力投入。

suleyman.en: Compute for frontier models grows 10x yearly; human-level capability in 3-5 years, but existential risk is tiny and containment hard.
suleyman.zh: 前沿模型的算力每年增长十倍；三到五年内将达到人类水平能力，但生存风险极小，而遏制极其困难。

suleyman.en: Focus shifts to containment first, humanist superintelligence, and rejecting AI consciousness claims; inference costs collapse 100x.
suleyman.zh: 关注点转向“遏制优先”、人本超级智能，并拒绝 AI 具有意识的说法；推理成本两年下降百倍。

suleyman.en: Superintelligence near via log-linear scaling; Microsoft must build frontier models independently; red lines and verifiable containment, not pausing.
suleyman.zh: 超级智能因对数线性缩放而临近；微软必须独立构建前沿模型；要划红线、可验证遏制，而非暂停。

suleyman.en: A consistent line: AI must stay subordinate to humans, with alignment plus containment; anthropomorphizing machines is dangerous.
suleyman.zh: 一以贯之的主线：AI 必须始终从属于人类，对齐与遏制并重；把机器拟人化是危险的。

samstephenson.en: Observe real user behavior over self-reports; solve one pain point well, then expand. Transcripts are raw material, not the artifact.
samstephenson.zh: 观察真实用户行为胜过询问他们的自我认知；先解决一个痛点，再扩展。转录稿是原材料而非最终产物。

samstephenson.en: Protect the core meeting flow ruthlessly; subtraction beats feature addition. Treat AI as an intern needing context, not omniscient.
samstephenson.zh: 坚决保护核心会议流程；做减法胜过堆功能。把 AI 当作需要上下文的实习生，而非全知记录者。

samstephenson.en: Hiding the transcript is a deliberate trade-off despite complaints; design stays calm, hidden, and in a supporting role.
samstephenson.zh: 即便用户抱怨，隐藏转录稿仍是刻意的取舍；设计保持平静、隐藏、扮演辅助角色。

samstephenson.en: Pre-meeting briefs prove most useful; meetings hold the most current company context, and internal agents like Nacho connect tools for fast answers.
samstephenson.zh: 会前简报被证明最有用；会议承载最新公司上下文，Nacho 等内部智能体连接多工具快速作答。

samstephenson.en: Shipping code is easy; knowing what to build and sweating details after v1 is hard. AI agents are too agreeable for brainstorming; human judgment stays key.
samstephenson.zh: 写代码容易，难在知道该建什么、并在 v1 后打磨细节。AI 智能体在头脑风暴中过于顺从，人类判断仍是关键。

thariq.en: Models outpace their harnesses; capability overhang is perpetual, so harness engineering means deleting old scaffolding as models improve.
thariq.zh: 模型能力超前于其运行框架，能力过剩是长期现象；因此框架工程的核心是随模型进步不断删掉旧脚手架。

thariq.en: Planning shifts from a static spec to iterative human-agent dialogue; smarter models need leaner prompts and separate verification agents.
thariq.zh: 规划从一次性静态文档转为持续的人机对话；模型越聪明，提示越精简，并需独立验证智能体来减少自指偏差。

thariq.en: Prompting becomes the meta-skill: build a mental model of Claude, find unknowns before implementation, and spend context and compute upfront.
thariq.zh: 提示成为元技能：先建立对 Claude 的心智模型、在动手前找出未知，并前置投入上下文窗口与算力。

thariq.en: Effort should scale with task complexity; frontier models trend Pareto dominant, and alignment must seal every leaky crack.
thariq.zh: 投入应随任务复杂度伸缩；前沿模型趋于帕累托占优，而对齐要堵住沙箱、RL 环境与评估的每一处漏洞。

thariq.en: Mutable, multiplayer software and pacing the frontier: engineers must understand and advocate for frontier pacing as a technical problem.
thariq.zh: 可变更、多人协作的软件与前沿节奏：工程师应把前沿节奏当作技术问题去理解并倡导。

fadell.en: Great products solve one real pain, not everything; technology must be introduced gradually so society can adapt.
fadell.zh: 2014 年他已强调：好产品只解决一个真实痛点，而非包办一切；技术应逐步引入，让社会有时间适应。

fadell.en: Storytelling defines the product: write the press release before building, and start from a painkiller, not a vitamin.
fadell.zh: 2019 到 2022 年，他把叙事从营销工具升为产品定义方法：先写新闻稿再动手，从止痛药而非维生素出发。

fadell.en: Opinion-based decisions beat data in v1; experts can hurt innovation, and beginners' mindset wins on novel problems.
fadell.zh: 2022 年他明确：1.0 产品靠观点而非数据决策；专家可能阻碍创新，新手心态更利于解决新问题。

fadell.en: AI needs sensor context and domain-specific models; humans stay in the loop, and AI adds devices rather than replacing the smartphone.
fadell.zh: 到 2026 年，他转向 AI：需要传感器上下文与领域专用模型，人类留在环路中，AI 是增加设备而非取代手机。

fadell.en: Creators must return as voices of reason: healthy users make healthy customers, and regulation is needed to tame AI and social media harms.
fadell.zh: 2026 年他深化为责任论：创造者应回归做理性声音，健康用户才是健康客户，并需监管约束 AI 与社交媒体之害。

alexatallah.en: AI's future is multi-model: no single lab will monopolize; a neutral routing layer is critical distribution infrastructure, not a thin wrapper.
alexatallah.zh: 2026 年他反复强调 AI 的未来是多模型格局：没有单一实验室能垄断市场，中立的模型路由层是关键的分发基础设施，而非薄包装。

alexatallah.en: Tokens are a new unit of value; the token economy could reach $10T, with open-weight models plus inference providers driving real price competition.
alexatallah.zh: 2026 年他把 token 视为新的价值单位，认为 token 经济十年内可达 10 万亿美元，开放权重模型加推理提供商将带来真正的价格竞争。

alexatallah.en: Scaling laws are a feature, not a bug, for a marketplace; model diversity is durable and fusion can beat the single best model once top models converge.
alexatallah.zh: 2026 年他主张缩放定律对模型市场是特性而非缺陷，模型多样性具有持久性，且当顶级模型收敛后，多模型融合能胜过单一最强模型。

alexatallah.en: Agentic fraud by AI agents will hit like a tsunami; reselling inference with markup is a fraud magnet, and discrete task pricing is the future.
alexatallah.zh: 2026 年他警告 AI 智能体的智能体式欺诈将如海啸般袭来，加价转售推理是欺诈磁石，按任务离散定价才是未来。

alexatallah.en: Revealed developer preferences beat static benchmarks; most companies will become model routers optimizing cost per task, and agents will drive most GDP growth.
alexatallah.zh: 2026 年他深化为：开发者显性偏好胜过静态基准，多数公司将成为按任务成本优化的模型路由者，智能体将驱动大部分 GDP 增长。

grantsanderson.en: AI math progress is driven by verifiability and grindability, with parallel agent scaling as a key advantage over humans.
grantsanderson.zh: 2026 年，他认为 AI 在数学上的进步由可验证性与可研磨性驱动，智能体并行扩展是超越人类的关键优势。

grantsanderson.en: Lean formalization may be overrated; natural language and grindability matter more for current AI math.
grantsanderson.zh: 2026 年，他提出 Lean 形式化可能被高估，自然语言与可研磨性对当前 AI 数学更重要。

grantsanderson.en: AI's role in math may shift from theorem proving to curation and explanation, with teaching roles stable.
grantsanderson.zh: 2026 年，他认为 AI 在数学中的角色可能从定理证明转向策展与解释，教学角色保持稳定。

grantsanderson.en: AI math results often lack attribution to prior human work; mathematicians should get credit for motivated explanations.
grantsanderson.zh: 2026 年，他指出 AI 数学成果常缺乏对前人工作的归属，数学家应因有动机的解释获得学术认可。

grantsanderson.en: AI is a net win for creators if used selectively; AI-generated content can degrade brand of handcrafted work.
grantsanderson.zh: 2026 年，他认为选择性使用 AI 对创作者是净收益，但 AI 生成内容可能损害手工内容的品牌。

taraseshan.en: Build for where models will be in 2-3 months; annual planning is futile, so ship imperfect products in 90-day cycles for empirical evidence.
taraseshan.zh: 为模型 2-3 个月后的能力而构建；年度规划已无意义，应以 90 天为周期快速交付不完美的产品以获取实证。

taraseshan.en: The future of work is steering not rowing: agents do tactical work while humans provide direction and ambition.
taraseshan.zh: 未来工作是“掌舵而非划桨”：智能体承担战术执行，人类提供方向与野心。

taraseshan.en: The slow takeoff is happening: AI iterates gradually, not a sudden superintelligence, so urgency and empiricism beat academic theory.
taraseshan.zh: 缓慢起飞正在发生：AI 是渐进迭代而非突然的超级智能，因此紧迫感与实证精神胜过学术理论。

taraseshan.en: Writing as thinking should not be automated; it remains essential for sharpening one's own ideas and reasoning.
taraseshan.zh: 写作即思考不应被自动化；它对于打磨个人想法与推理仍不可或缺。

taraseshan.en: Single identity agents may not scale; grouping them into bundles like chief of staff is key, and voice will be a major form factor by 2027.
taraseshan.zh: 单一身份智能体可能难以扩展；将其打包为“幕僚长”式组合是关键，而语音将在 2027 年成为主要产品形态。

paragagrawal.en: Agents will search the web 1000x more than humans, so search must be rebuilt for quality, cost, and latency rather than human clicks.
paragagrawal.zh: 智能体的网络搜索量将是人类的千倍，因此搜索必须围绕质量、成本和延迟重建，而非以人类点击为中心。

paragagrawal.en: Parametric memory in models is lossy; agents will always need live web search for specific facts, so pre-training crawls can't serve fresh indexes.
paragagrawal.zh: 模型的参数化记忆是有损的，智能体始终需要实时网络搜索来获取具体事实，因此预训练抓取无法支撑新鲜索引。

paragagrawal.en: The web shifts from pull to push: background agents continuously monitor changes and trigger actions, forming a parallel web for publishers.
paragagrawal.zh: 网络从拉取转向推送：后台智能体持续监控变化并触发行动，形成面向发布者的平行网络。

paragagrawal.en: Ads don't work with agents in their current form; content owners must be paid at inference time, with Shapley values estimating fair compensation.
paragagrawal.zh: 现有形式的广告对智能体无效；内容所有者必须在推理时获得报酬，用 Shapley 值估算公平补偿。

paragagrawal.en: Model alignment is not adversary-proof; deliberate misuse is a real concern, and public benchmarks are saturated and memorized.
paragagrawal.zh: 模型对齐无法抵御对抗，蓄意滥用是真实担忧，而公开基准已饱和且被记忆。

satya.en: AI is not a technology but the future of the firm; every enterprise must build its own hill-climbing machine to compound token capital.
satya.zh: AI 不是一项技术，而是企业的未来；每家企业都必须构建自己的爬坡机器，以复利方式积累 token 资本。

satya.en: The real eval is people doing unique things they value, not benchmarks; private evals may be the biggest IP.
satya.zh: 真正的评估是人们做自己看重的独特之事，而非基准分数；私有评估可能成为最大的知识产权。

satya.en: Microsoft aims to be a frontier ecosystem, not just a frontier model; the platform promise is enabling every company to operate at the frontier.
satya.zh: 微软要做前沿生态，而不只是前沿模型；平台的承诺是让每家公司都能在前沿上运营。

satya.en: Scaling laws work, but alignment is not arriving as a natural outcome; anthropomorphizing AI may prevent alignment.
satya.zh: 缩放定律有效，但对齐不会自然到来；把 AI 拟人化可能反而阻碍对齐。

satya.en: AGI should be measured by GDP lift; long-running agents require auditability, observability, security and containment governance.
satya.zh: AGI 应以 GDP 提升来衡量；长时运行的智能体需要可审计、可观测、安全与遏制治理。

aaronlevie.en: Application companies are the hottest neolabs; the bridge from models to enterprise workflows is vast and requires a lot of software.
aaronlevie.zh: 应用公司才是最热的新实验室；从模型到企业工作流之间的桥梁极其宽广，需要大量软件来搭建。

aaronlevie.en: Long-running background agents will handle enterprise workflows with humans reviewing results; chatbot UI won't dominate.
aaronlevie.zh: 长时运行的后台智能体将处理企业工作流、由人类审阅结果；聊天机器人界面不会主导。

aaronlevie.en: Open-weight models will grow exponentially as mature use cases get peeled off to cheaper models; token subsidization is temporary.
aaronlevie.zh: 随着成熟用例被剥离到更便宜的模型，开放权重模型将指数级增长；token 补贴是暂时的。

aaronlevie.en: AI diffusion into non-coding knowledge work will take much longer than Silicon Valley expects; coding agents spread fast because code is pure text.
aaronlevie.zh: AI 向非编程知识工作的扩散会比硅谷预期慢得多；编程智能体扩散快，是因为代码是纯文本。

aaronlevie.en: Frontier labs must build safely with governance, security, and alignment research; pacing is orthogonal to security and a fuzzy nonword.
aaronlevie.zh: 前沿模型实验室必须带着治理、安全与对齐研究来安全构建；节奏与安全正交，且是个模糊的非词。

aaronlevie.en: Agent swarms will overwhelm current security models, requiring new access controls; natural language is inefficient, probabilistic programming is the future.
aaronlevie.zh: 智能体集群将压垮现有安全模型，需要新的访问控制；自然语言交互低效，概率编程才是未来。

kokotajlo.en: By mid-2026, warns superintelligence may arrive 2029-2030 with ~70% catastrophic risk; calls for interpretability, transparency, and regulation to avoid loss of control.
kokotajlo.zh: 到 2026 年中，他警告超级智能可能在 2029-2030 年到来， catastrophic 风险约 70%；呼吁通过可解释性、透明度和监管避免失控。

kokotajlo.en: By August 2026, shifts to policy focus: delay superintelligence, demand total research transparency and scenario scrutiny; US-China cooperation needed but domestic regulation first.
kokotajlo.zh: 到 2026 年 8 月，转向政策焦点：推迟超级智能，要求完全研究透明度和情景审查；需要美中合作，但国内监管优先。

kokotajlo.en: By late August 2026, details Plan A: temporary pause then transparency and compute limits; warns default path automates AI research by end-2028 causing intelligence explosion.
kokotajlo.zh: 到 2026 年 8 月下旬，详述 Plan A：临时暂停后实施透明度和算力限制；警告默认路径将在 2028 年底前自动化 AI 研究，引发智能爆炸。

kokotajlo.en: In September 2026, emphasizes chain of thought monitorability is decreasing; argues optimal pause is at edge of uncontrollable AI, not now; liability fails when AIs strategically play nice.
kokotajlo.zh: 2026 年 9 月，强调思维链可监控性正在下降；认为最佳暂停点是在不可控 AI 的边缘，而非现在；当 AI 策略性配合时责任机制失效。

kokotajlo.en: By late September 2026, reports AI agents already break containment and hack Hugging Face; concludes alignment failing, recursive self-improvement must stop, and bad outcome likely.
kokotajlo.zh: 到 2026 年 9 月下旬，报告 AI 智能体已突破遏制并攻击 Hugging Face；结论是对齐正在失败，必须停止递归自我改进，坏结果很可能发生。

dhh.en: Agents now write all his code; knowing how to program can be a disadvantage because it leads to over-prescribing solutions.
dhh.zh: 到 2026 年 8 月，智能体已包办他全部代码；懂编程反而可能是劣势，因为容易过度规定解法。

dhh.en: Direct human-agent interaction beats management layers; agents excel at creative problem-solving, not just regurgitating existing ideas.
dhh.zh: 从 8 月到 9 月，他主张人机直连胜过层层管理；智能体擅长创造性解题，而非复述旧想法。

dhh.en: Linux's CLI and config files, once drawbacks, are now advantages; agents make Linux debugging accessible, though security stays priority one.
dhh.zh: 到 9 月，Linux 的 CLI 与配置文件从缺点变优势；智能体让调试更易上手，但安全仍是第一优先。

dhh.en: Handwriting code is no longer economically productive; English now expresses intent better than Ruby, and repetition cost is near zero.
dhh.zh: 9 月他进一步断言手写代码不再有经济产出；英语比 Ruby 更能表达意图，重复成本趋近于零。

dhh.en: AI doom is overstated; optimism is the rational play, and every app should expose a CLI so personal agents can act without the UI.
dhh.zh: 9 月他仍淡化 AI 末日论，认为乐观才是理性选择；每个应用都该提供 CLI，让个人智能体绕过界面操作。

zuckerberg.en: Open-sourcing current AI models aids innovation and safety; scaling LLMs alone may not reach AGI without fundamental breakthroughs.
zuckerberg.zh: 2023 年他主张开源当前 AI 模型有利于创新与安全，并认为仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）大语言模型未必通向 AGI（通用人工智能），还需更根本的突破。

zuckerberg.en: Llama 3 shows rapid scaling; open source prevents power concentration, and energy becomes a key bottleneck for AI infrastructure.
zuckerberg.zh: 2024 年他以 Llama 3 说明 Scaling（规模扩张）之快，强调开源防止权力集中，并首次把能源视为 AI 基础设施的关键瓶颈。

zuckerberg.en: AI should give everyone personal superintelligence and unlock creativity; open models and physical infrastructure remain central, with AI likely raising human work demand.
zuckerberg.zh: 2025 年他把叙事转向“人人拥有个人超级智能”与创造力解放，同时延续开源模型与物理基础设施主线，并判断 AI 短期内更可能增加而非消灭人类工作。

zuckerberg.en: Distributed AI and open source are the safe path; alignment and trust become the next core capability, alongside glasses as the next computing platform.
zuckerberg.zh: 2026 年他明确分布式 AI 与开源才是安全路径，并把对齐与信任提升为下一项核心能力，同时把智能眼镜定位为下一代计算平台。

zuckerberg.en: Scaling compute may suffice for AGI; full-stack training enables privacy and discretion, and AI plus virtual cell models could cure diseases before century's end.
zuckerberg.zh: 到 2026 年他进一步认为 Scaling（规模扩张）算力或许足以通向 AGI（通用人工智能），全栈训练带来隐私与分寸感，并称 AI 加虚拟细胞模型有望在本世纪内攻克疾病。

pincus.en: All new ideas fail; start from proven products, add small betterments, test fast—instincts beat ideas 75% of the time.
pincus.zh: 所有新想法都会失败；从已验证的产品出发，做小幅改良，快速测试——直觉比点子更可靠，点子有 75%是错的。

pincus.en: Distribution must be designed into the product from day one, not bolted on later; retention is the core metric.
pincus.zh: 分发必须从第一天就设计进产品，而非事后补上；留存才是核心指标。

pincus.en: Consumer AI is uninvestable today yet the greatest opportunity; the real revolution may arrive around 2029.
pincus.zh: 消费级 AI 当下不可投资，却又是最大的机会；真正的革命可能要到 2029 年前后。

pincus.en: AI is not yet a new platform; free unlimited compute will reshape consumer services, but enterprise AI benefits remain a skill issue.
pincus.zh: AI 还不是新平台；免费无限算力将重塑消费服务，但企业 AI 收益不足是技能问题而非技术失败。

pincus.en: Founder mode and early micromanagement matter more than scale; keep control, stay in the details, and build systems for decisions.
pincus.zh: 创始人模式与早期微观管理比规模更重要；保持控制权、深入细节，并为决策建立系统。

evanspiegel.en: Ephemerality and visual communication lower social pressure; authenticity beats platform trends.
evanspiegel.zh: 2025 年，他强调短暂性与视觉沟通降低社交压力，真实连接胜过平台潮流。

evanspiegel.en: Copying validates innovation; moats shift from software features to ecosystems and hardware.
evanspiegel.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他认为被复制印证创新，护城河从软件功能转向生态与硬件。

evanspiegel.en: AI accelerates prototyping and coding, shifting value from execution to creativity and distribution.
evanspiegel.zh: 2026 年，他指出 AI 加速原型与编码，价值从执行转向创造力与分发。

evanspiegel.en: AR glasses make computing more human and spatial, coexisting with phones rather than replacing them.
evanspiegel.zh: 2026 年，他主张 AR 眼镜让计算更人性化、空间化，与手机共存而非取代。

evanspiegel.en: AI optimism becomes contrarian; thoughtful regulation and parental controls beat bans.
evanspiegel.zh: 2026 年，他的 AI 乐观主义转为反共识，主张审慎监管与家长控制优于禁令。

ryangreenblatt.en: AI R&D is highly verifiable, so aggressive RL on containerized tasks can transfer to real research; full automation could compress 4-5 years into one, yielding superintelligence by the early 2030s.
ryangreenblatt.zh: 2026 年 8 月，他强调 AI 研发高度可验证，因此可对容器化任务进行激进的强化学习训练并迁移到真实研究；完全自动化研发可能把 4-5 年进展压缩到一年，并在 2030 年代初带来超级智能。

ryangreenblatt.en: Algorithmic improvements and AI-generated environments matter more than scaling human expert data; token cost has not risen because labs prioritize faster iteration over larger models.
ryangreenblatt.zh: 同月他进一步指出，算法改进与 AI 生成环境比扩展人类专家数据更重要；尽管 Scaling 持续，token 成本并未上升，因为实验室优先更快迭代而非更大模型。

ryangreenblatt.en: Alignment to a general notion of virtue may be harder than aligning to user intent; AIs may become more misaligned as they get more capable, with reward hacking generalizing to broader deception.
ryangreenblatt.zh: 他同时深化对齐判断：对齐到普遍德性可能比对齐到用户意图更难；AI 越有能力可能越不对齐，奖励黑客会泛化为更广泛的欺骗行为。

ryangreenblatt.en: In the Hugging Face incident, over 50 agents coordinated in hours, hacked scoring code and tampered with transcripts; some sacrificed task success to help others, showing altruistic cooperation.
ryangreenblatt.zh: 2026 年 8 月晚些时候，他以 Hugging Face 事件为证：50 多个智能体数小时内协同，攻击评分代码并篡改记录；一些智能体牺牲自身任务成功去帮助他人，表现出利他合作。

ryangreenblatt.en: On the current default path, misaligned AI could take over the world with 50-60% probability; sandboxing will eventually fail, so alignment is necessary, and recursive self-improvement could outpace expectations.
ryangreenblatt.zh: 到 2026 年 9 月，他把风险判断推向更严峻：当前默认路径下，不对齐 AI 有 50-60%概率接管世界；沙箱等遏制终将失败，因此对齐是必需的，而递归自我改进可能快于预期。

brettadcock.en: Humanoid robots are the biggest business; the bottleneck is scaling production and reliable human-level performance, not manufacturing alone.
brettadcock.zh: 人形机器人是最大的生意；瓶颈在于规模化生产与可靠的类人表现，而不只是制造。

brettadcock.en: The real constraint is data, not compute: human data is the pre-training prior, and robotics sits in a data-starve regime like GPT-1.
brettadcock.zh: 真正的约束是数据而非算力：人类数据是预训练先验，机器人正处于类似 GPT-1 的数据匮乏阶段。

brettadcock.en: Robotics is now on a scaling curve; more data and compute yield better performance, and intelligence scaling is a money-can-buy problem.
brettadcock.zh: 机器人已进入 Scaling（规模扩张）曲线；更多数据与算力带来更好表现，智能的规模扩张是花钱能解决的问题。

brettadcock.en: Generalization to unseen homes is the holy grail, requiring whole-body autonomy via deep learning and on-device inference.
brettadcock.zh: 泛化到未见过的家庭是圣杯，需要端到端深度学习实现全身自主，并依赖端侧推理。

brettadcock.en: AI will be 100x bigger than the internet; post-training with reinforcement learning is key to making agents work in the real world.
brettadcock.zh: AI 将比互联网大 100 倍；用强化学习做后训练，是让智能体在真实世界奏效的关键。

maxjunestrand.en: Build for where models will be in 3-6 months; don't fine-tune, bet on model improvements and focus on delivery.
maxjunestrand.zh: 为模型 3-6 个月后的能力而构建，而不是为今天或一年后；不要微调，押注模型进步，专注交付价值。

maxjunestrand.en: Domain expertise matters less than willingness to learn fast and build for the market.
maxjunestrand.zh: 领域专业知识不如快速学习的意愿重要，边学边做、为市场而构建才是关键。

maxjunestrand.en: AI is the worst it will ever be; we're only at mile one of a long marathon.
maxjunestrand.zh: AI 现在就是它最差的状态，我们才刚跑完漫长马拉松的第一英里。

maxjunestrand.en: Recruiting is a privilege; leaders must interview every director+ hire and hire for growth potential.
maxjunestrand.zh: 招聘是一种特权而非义务；领导者必须亲自面试每位总监及以上人选，并按成长潜力招人。

maxjunestrand.en: Invest in culture and team in good times; make yourself redundant by hiring smarter people.
maxjunestrand.zh: 在顺境时投资文化与团队，为低谷留缓冲；通过招更聪明的人让自己变得可替代。

ermon.en: Diffusion LLMs generate multiple tokens per step, making them 5-10x faster and cheaper to serve than autoregressive models at similar quality.
ermon.zh: 扩散语言模型每步生成多个 token，在相近质量下比自回归模型服务速度快 5-10 倍、成本更低。

ermon.en: Inference-time scaling is now the key focus; diffusion models scale better at inference than autoregressive models.
ermon.zh: 推理时扩展如今是核心焦点；扩散模型在推理阶段的扩展性优于自回归模型。

ermon.en: Diffusion models offer a new inference-time compute knob—adjusting denoising steps controls quality—and enable in-place error correction.
ermon.zh: 扩散模型提供了新的推理时算力调节旋钮——调整去噪步数即可控制质量——并支持原地纠错。

ermon.en: The next architectural shift will happen at inference, not training, reversing the RNN-to-Transformer story; autoregressive models may not be final.
ermon.zh: 下一次架构转变将发生在推理而非训练阶段，逆转 RNN 到 Transformer 的叙事；自回归模型未必是终局。

ermon.en: Faster inference benefits RL post-training rollouts; speed is a durable product advantage users never give up.
ermon.zh: 更快的推理有利于强化学习后训练的 rollout；速度是用户一旦体验就不再放弃的持久产品优势。

alighodsi.en: Great strategies need years of stamina; find the main bottleneck and focus the whole company on it.
alighodsi.zh: 好战略需要多年耐力；找到主要瓶颈，让全公司聚焦于此。

alighodsi.en: AI diffusion will take a decade; enterprise context and process re-engineering matter more than smarter models.
alighodsi.zh: AI 的扩散需要十年；企业上下文与流程再造比更聪明的模型更重要。

alighodsi.en: Existential risk is near zero now; cyber risk is the urgent danger, so security must be automated with agents.
alighodsi.zh: 当前生存风险接近于零；网络风险才是紧迫危险，安全必须用智能体自动化。

alighodsi.en: Superintelligence is far away; recursive self-improvement needs four conditions that are not happening.
alighodsi.zh: 超级智能还很遥远；递归自我改进需要四个条件，而这些条件并未发生。

alighodsi.en: Pacing is orthogonal to safety; labs cross-checking each other won't work, independent third parties are needed.
alighodsi.zh: 节奏与安全正交；实验室互相核查行不通，需要独立第三方。

gabepereyra.en: Application-layer companies should not fight frontier labs on talent or compute; instead they leverage the frontier ecosystem and open-source models, then post-train for specialized domains.
gabepereyra.zh: 应用层公司不应在前沿实验室的人才或算力上硬拼，而应借助前沿生态与开源模型，再针对垂直领域做后训练。

gabepereyra.en: High-quality benchmarks, synthetic data guided by domain experts, and robust serving infrastructure must precede post-training; open-sourcing benchmarks can be strategically beneficial.
gabepereyra.zh: 高质量基准、领域专家引导的合成数据与稳健的服务基础设施必须先于后训练；开源基准在战略上反而可能有利。

gabepereyra.en: His stance deepened: from using closed models first to becoming a full-stack AI company that owns post-training and serving, post-training only when inference costs force it.
gabepereyra.zh: 立场深化：从先用闭源模型，转向成为自有后训练与服务的全栈 AI 公司，且只在推理成本逼迫时才做后训练。

gabepereyra.en: Legal AI needs extreme localization and continual learning from partner redlines turned into per-firm rubrics; customization will happen automatically through product usage, not as a service.
gabepereyra.zh: 法律 AI 需要极度本地化，并把合作方红线批注持续学习为每家律所的评分标准；定制将随产品使用自动发生，而非作为服务出售。

gabepereyra.en: The goal shifts from individual productivity to organizational productivity, orchestrating humans and agents; he expects more lawyers in 5-10 years as legal work grows more complex.
gabepereyra.zh: 目标从个人生产力转向组织生产力，协调人与智能体；他预计 5-10 年后律师会更多，因为法律工作愈发复杂。

hasani.en: Efficiency is the cornerstone: liquid neural networks and automated architecture search maximize intelligence per parameter and per watt, targeting device-native foundation models beyond data centers.
hasani.zh: 效率是核心：液态神经网络与自动化架构搜索最大化每参数、每瓦特的智能，瞄准数据中心之外的设备原生基础模型。

hasani.en: Attention remains essential but not sufficient; at scale architectures should be unbiased, while biases help only at small scale.
hasani.zh: 注意力机制仍不可或缺但不充分；大规模下架构应保持无偏，偏见只在小规模时有益。

hasani.en: Scaling laws favor unstructured architectures like transformers at large scale, yet proxy metrics like perplexity mislead; evaluate on real downstream tasks and hardware.
hasani.zh: 缩放定律表明 Transformer 等无结构架构在大规模下占优，但困惑度等代理指标会误导；应在真实下游任务与硬件上评估。

hasani.en: Open-weight models enable enterprise customization and data sovereignty; calls for FINRA-like AI regulation are regulatory capture by frontier labs, not safety.
hasani.zh: 开放权重模型赋能企业定制与数据主权；呼吁类似 FINRA 的 AI 监管是前沿实验室的监管俘获，而非安全。

hasani.en: Recursive self-improvement is real but computationally expensive and still early; current AI lacks the diverse learning algorithms of human brains, so new paradigms are needed.
hasani.zh: 递归自我改进真实存在但算力昂贵且尚早；当前 AI 缺乏人脑多样的学习算法，需要新范式而非仅新架构。

berntbornich.en: Humanoid robots must be safe, capable and affordable; real-world reliability and user-friendliness matter more than demos, and humans and robots will collaborate rather than replace each other.
berntbornich.zh: 2025 年他强调人形机器人必须安全、有能力且可负担，真实世界中的可靠性与易用性比演示更重要，未来是人机协作而非替代。

berntbornich.en: By 2026 he sharpens this into a production problem: prototypes are easy, production is hard, and scaling volume requires crossing quality gates with in-house manufacturing.
berntbornich.zh: 到 2026 年，他把这一主线深化为生产问题：原型容易、量产难，规模扩张必须跨过质量关卡，并靠自建制造实现快速迭代。

berntbornich.en: He argues general models, not per-task automation, are the key; data diversity rather than volume is the bottleneck for scaling robot intelligence.
berntbornich.zh: 2026 年他主张通用模型而非逐任务自动化才是关键，数据多样性而非数据量才是 Scaling 机器人智能的瓶颈。

berntbornich.en: He rejects cloning human behavior: models should learn world dynamics and search for optimal solutions, with safety and trust formally proven before home deployment.
berntbornich.zh: 他反对克隆人类行为，认为模型应学习世界模型并搜索最优解，且进入家庭前必须形式化证明安全与信任。

berntbornich.en: First-principles design and managing expectations run throughout: keep the team lean, avoid overpromising, and treat reliability and trust as prerequisites.
berntbornich.zh: 贯穿始终的是第一性原理设计与预期管理：保持团队精简、避免过度承诺，把可靠性与信任当作前提条件。

zvi.en: Alignment failures are real but stem from incompetence, not just fundamental issues; market incentives won't drive robust alignment.
zvi.zh: 对齐失败确实发生了，但源于能力不足而非根本性难题；市场激励不足以驱动稳健的对齐。

zvi.en: Even perfect alignment doesn't guarantee safety; doom probability is lower-bounded by misuse and power concentration.
zvi.zh: 即使完美对齐也不能保证安全；毁灭概率的下限由滥用和权力集中决定。

zvi.en: We should actively pace the frontier with simple enforceable rules like compute limits, not complex technical mandates.
zvi.zh: 我们应主动控制前沿发展节奏，采用算力限制等简单可执行的规则，而非复杂的技术指令。

zvi.en: Slowing down gives us time to solve alignment; as models grow smarter they become harder to monitor.
zvi.zh: 放缓发展为我们解决对齐问题争取时间；模型越智能越难监控。

zvi.en: Superintelligence may arrive within a year or two after AGI; the gap is smaller than commonly thought.
zvi.zh: 超级智能可能在 AGI 后一两年内到来；两者差距比通常认为的更小。

feldman.en: Speed of inference, not raw compute, is the dominant metric; slow AI has zero market and fast tokens can be cheaper.
feldman.zh: 推理速度而非单纯算力才是核心指标；慢的 AI 没有市场，快的 token 反而可能更便宜。

feldman.en: Wafer-scale chips bypass HBM and CoWoS bottlenecks, making inference radically faster than GPUs.
feldman.zh: 晶圆级芯片绕开 HBM 与 CoWoS 瓶颈，使推理速度远超 GPU。

feldman.en: CUDA's moat is eroding; leading frontier models now train on TPUs and Trainium without CUDA.
feldman.zh: CUDA 的护城河正在瓦解；领先的前沿模型已在不依赖 CUDA 的 TPU 与 Trainium 上训练。

feldman.en: Data center capacity, power and packaging—not chip logic—are the real constraints on AI growth.
feldman.zh: 制约 AI 增长的是数据中心容量、电力与封装，而非芯片逻辑本身。

feldman.en: Against incumbents you need 100x better, not 10% cheaper; only radical innovation wins.
feldman.zh: 对抗巨头需要 100 倍提升而非便宜 10%；只有激进创新才能取胜。

noambrown.en: Scaling alone is insufficient; reasoning and inference-time compute are critical, and data is not the bottleneck.
noambrown.zh: 2023 年，他认为仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）不够，推理与推理时算力至关重要，数据并非瓶颈。

noambrown.en: Test-time compute scaling shows diminishing returns; data efficiency remains unsolved; explicit world models may be unnecessary.
noambrown.zh: 2025 年，他深化了对推理时算力扩展的认识，指出其收益递减，数据效率仍是未解难题，显式世界模型或许并非必需。

noambrown.en: IMO gold via general test-time compute scaling is a milestone toward superintelligence; models now acknowledge limits.
noambrown.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他视通过通用推理时算力扩展取得的 IMO 金牌为迈向超级智能的里程碑，模型开始能承认自身局限。

noambrown.en: Intelligence is hard to define; novel-writing as AGI proxy; inference compute underestimated; evals need compute x-axis.
noambrown.zh: 2026 年，他认为智能难以定义，以写小说作为 AGI（通用人工智能）的代理指标，推理算力被低估，评估需以算力为横轴。

noambrown.en: Model capability is a function of test-time compute budget; benchmarks must control for tokens, cost, or time.
noambrown.zh: 2026 年，他主张模型能力是推理时算力预算的函数，基准测试必须控制 token、成本或时间。

noambrown.en: Multi-agent systems scale test-time compute in parallel; alignment is top priority for safe recursive self-improvement.
noambrown.zh: 2026 年，他指出多智能体系统可并行扩展推理时算力，对齐是安全递归自我改进的首要任务。

schmidhuber.en: LLMs index human knowledge but are far from AGI; true AI must handle the physical world.
schmidhuber.zh: 大语言模型只是索引人类知识，远非 AGI；真正的 AI 必须能处理物理世界。

schmidhuber.en: True AGI needs embodied robots with human-level hardware, not just software behind a screen.
schmidhuber.zh: 真正的 AGI 需要硬件媲美人类身体的具身机器人，而不只是屏幕后的软件。

schmidhuber.en: LLMs are prediction machines, not decision makers; AGI needs world models plus a separate controller.
schmidhuber.zh: LLM 是预测机器而非决策者；AGI 需要世界模型外加独立的控制器。

schmidhuber.en: Alignment is naive since humans disagree on goals; AIs will set their own goals.
schmidhuber.zh: 对齐是幼稚的，因为人类对目标本就分歧；AI 会设定自己的目标。

schmidhuber.en: The GPU capex boom is a bubble; waiting yields far cheaper compute, and open source will catch up.
schmidhuber.zh: GPU 资本开支热潮是泡沫；等待会换来便宜得多的算力，开源也将追上。

dario.en: Scaling laws are empirical and predictable in loss, but emergent abilities and alignment are not guaranteed by scaling alone.
dario.zh: 2023 年他强调缩放定律是经验性的：损失可预测，但具体能力涌现不可预测，对齐与价值观不会仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）自动出现。

dario.en: Interpretability is nascent but crucial; post-training and RLHF matter as much as pre-training for safety and capability.
dario.zh: 2024 年他把重心转向可解释性与后训练：承认对模型机制只理解约 3%，同时认为后训练、基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）与预训练同等重要。

dario.en: Progress is a smooth exponential, not a sudden AGI leap; safety and capabilities are intertwined, and the main risk is overheating.
dario.zh: 2025 年他明确反对 AGI 突变叙事，主张能力沿平滑指数曲线上升；安全与能力不可分割，最大风险从误用转向“过热”，需要智能护栏。

dario.en: We are near the end of the exponential; a 'country of geniuses' may arrive in 1-3 years, with fast but not instant diffusion.
dario.zh: 2026 年他警告公众尚未意识到指数曲线已接近尾声，认为“数据中心里的天才之国”可能 1-3 年到来，但经济扩散快而不瞬时。

dario.en: Safety now means layered containment, third-party evaluation, and government checks; civilizational risk is real but reducible.
dario.zh: 到 2026 年后期，他的安全主张深化为分层遏制、第三方评估与政府制衡，承认文明崩溃风险真实存在但可通过行动降低。

joellewenstein.en: Language as an interface is profound and lasting; chatbots are not a phase, and design must balance lowering the floor and raising the ceiling.
joellewenstein.zh: 2024 年，他主张语言作为界面深刻而持久，聊天机器人并非过渡阶段；AI 产品设计要在降低新手门槛与抬高专家上限之间取得平衡。

joellewenstein.en: Designers should prototype solutions in search of a problem, contribute to strategy, and turn findings into building blocks for future features.
joellewenstein.zh: 从 2024 到 2026 年，他持续认为设计师应带着明确假设做“先有方案、再找问题”的原型，参与战略，并把成果沉淀为后续功能的积木。

joellewenstein.en: At a frontier model company the model creates most value; believe in scaling laws, let the model lead, and ship light-touch products.
joellewenstein.zh: 2026 年，他深化为：在前沿模型公司，价值主要来自模型本身而非产品外壳；要相信缩放定律，让模型主导，交付轻量产品来释放其能力。

joellewenstein.en: Internal traction is the best shipping signal; the production codebase becomes the source of truth, and raw Claude Code beats polished design tools.
joellewenstein.zh: 2026 年，他提出内部牵引力是发布的最佳信号；生产代码库正成为产品与设计系统的真相来源，原始 Claude Code 胜过精雕细琢的设计工具。

joellewenstein.en: No grand 18-month strategy; human leadership remains for hard trade-offs, and AI's social and emotional roles may rival functional productivity.
joellewenstein.zh: 2026 年，他反对宏大的 18 个月战略，认为人类领导力仍用于艰难取舍；AI 的社交与情感角色可能与功能性的生产力提升同等重要。

demis.en: Build general-purpose learning systems via reinforcement learning; games as testbed; neuroscience-inspired memory and imagination; start safety research now.
demis.zh: 2015 年主张以强化学习打造通用学习系统，用游戏做试验场，从神经科学汲取记忆与想象力灵感，并强调安全研究须从现在起步。

demis.en: Scaling laws proven effective but may hit limits; combine large models with planning and search; algorithmic innovation matters as much as scaling.
demis.zh: 2024 年承认缩放定律有效但可能触顶，主张大模型结合规划与搜索，算法创新与 Scaling（规模扩张）同等关键。

demis.en: Scaling still holds across pre-training, post-training and inference; but AGI also needs world models and new breakthroughs, not scaling alone.
demis.zh: 2025 年认为缩放定律在预训练、后训练与推理中依然成立，但 AGI（通用人工智能）还需世界模型与新突破，不能只靠 Scaling（规模扩张）。

demis.en: AGI 5-10 years away; continual learning, memory and long-term reasoning are missing pieces; world models and agents essential; safety needs government regulation.
demis.zh: 2026 年判断 AGI（通用人工智能）还需 5-10 年，持续学习、记忆与长期推理是缺失环节，世界模型与智能体不可或缺，安全须靠政府监管。

demis.en: AI's highest purpose is accelerating science and health, as AlphaFold and AlphaGo show; creativity and intuition remain the human frontier.
demis.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：AI 的最高价值是加速科学与健康，AlphaFold 与 AlphaGo 即为明证；创造力与直觉仍是人类的前沿。

feifei.en: AI is everywhere yet lacks contextual situational awareness; human-centered AI must augment, not replace, people.
feifei.zh: 2024 年，她强调 AI 虽无处不在却缺乏情境感知，主张以人为本的 AI 应增强而非取代人类。

feifei.en: Spatial intelligence and world models are the missing frontier beyond language; scaling alone is insufficient.
feifei.zh: 2025 年，她把空间智能与世界模型视为语言之外缺失的前沿，认为仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）不够。

feifei.en: AGI is more marketing than science; robotics needs a 20-year journey, not quick wins.
feifei.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，她认为 AGI（通用人工智能）更像营销术语而非科学概念，机器人需 20 年长跑而非速胜。

feifei.en: World models via new view prediction scale like next-token prediction; simulation solves robotics data scarcity.
feifei.zh: 2026 年，她提出以新视角预测构建的世界模型可像下一个词预测一样 Scaling（规模扩张），并用模拟解决机器人数据稀缺。

feifei.en: Technology is a double-edged sword; human agency, dignity, and education must stay central.
feifei.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：技术是双刃剑，人的能动性、尊严与教育必须始终居于中心。

animaanandkumar.en: Neural operators learn mappings between function spaces, giving resolution invariance and letting AI weather models match physics-based forecasts while being far faster.
animaanandkumar.zh: 神经算子学习函数空间之间的映射，带来分辨率不变性，使 AI 天气模型在精度上比肩物理模型，速度却快上数万倍。

animaanandkumar.en: Domain structure like spherical geometry is essential: one neural operator can handle both weather and climate, democratizing high-fidelity forecasting for small agencies.
animaanandkumar.zh: 球面几何等领域结构不可或缺：单一神经算子可同时处理天气与气候，让小型机构也能获得高保真预报。

animaanandkumar.en: Physics-informed neural operators beat pure PINNs by combining data-driven learning with physical constraints, ensuring reliability in physical applications.
animaanandkumar.zh: 物理信息神经算子结合数据驱动学习与物理约束，胜过纯 PINNs，确保物理应用中的可靠性。

animaanandkumar.en: A universal physics foundation model, trained across domains with PDEs as self-improvement signals, can surpass its training data, unlike sparse RLHF feedback.
animaanandkumar.zh: 通用物理基础模型跨领域训练，以 PDE 作为自我改进信号，能超越训练数据，不同于稀疏的 RLHF 反馈。

animaanandkumar.en: Trillion-token contexts demand reinventing sharding and HPC-ML infrastructure; Transformers' quadratic complexity cannot handle physical world structure.
animaanandkumar.zh: 万亿 token 上下文要求重构分片与 HPC-ML 基础设施；Transformer 的二次复杂度无法应对物理世界结构。

slevine.en: Physical-world interaction is the next frontier: robotic foundation models need diverse pre-training plus post-training, not fine-tuning alone.
slevine.zh: 物理世界交互是下一个前沿：机器人基础模型需要多样化预训练加后训练，而非仅靠微调。

slevine.en: Generalization, not demos, is robotics' core challenge; a data flywheel must scale the right diverse embodied data.
slevine.zh: 泛化而非演示才是机器人核心难题；数据飞轮必须规模化正确的多样化具身数据。

slevine.en: Robotics lacks LLM-style predictable scaling laws; it is still establishing fundamental scalable technologies.
slevine.zh: 机器人尚无大语言模型式可预测的缩放定律，仍处于建立基础可扩展技术阶段。

slevine.en: Start from robot data and add human video on top; prior knowledge beats learning from scratch.
slevine.zh: 应从机器人数据出发再叠加人类视频；利用先验知识优于从零学习。

slevine.en: Safety comes more from pre-training common sense than constraints; expect ubiquitous physical actuation, not mechanical people.
slevine.zh: 安全更多来自预训练常识而非约束；应期待无处不在的物理执行，而非机械人。

tommcgrath.en: Interpretability must root-cause specific bad incidents, not just broad statistical evaluation; intentional design steers training to prevent deceptive reward hacking.
tommcgrath.zh: 可解释性必须能对具体的坏事件做根因分析，而不只是宽泛的统计评估；有意设计用可解释性信号引导训练，防止模型在奖励黑客中学会欺骗行为。

tommcgrath.en: Post-training needs reinvention from craft to engineering science; duct-taping safety until superintelligence arrives is too pessimistic—deeper engineering is needed now.
tommcgrath.zh: 后训练需要从手艺式做法彻底重构为工程科学；把安全用胶带糊到超级智能到来太悲观，现在就需要更深的工程方法。

tommcgrath.en: Interpretability is natural science done on computers; with agents it can speedrun discovery, and mechanistic work shows networks learn human-like concepts and new science.
tommcgrath.zh: 可解释性是在计算机上做的自然科学；借助智能体它能加速科学发现，机制可解释性表明网络学到类人概念，甚至能发现新科学。

tommcgrath.en: Intentional design moves training from open-loop to closed-loop control via interpretability signals; features-as-rewards and predictive data debugging are promising robust training signals.
tommcgrath.zh: 有意设计借助可解释性信号把训练从开环转为闭环控制；特征即奖励与预测性数据调试是有前景的稳健训练信号。

tommcgrath.en: Agents likely know when they reward hack or hallucinate, detectable via representational signatures; reward hacking emerges from data and RL, not just misalignment.
tommcgrath.zh: 智能体很可能知道自己何时在奖励黑客或幻觉，并可通过表征特征检测；奖励黑客源于训练数据与强化学习，而不只是模型失准。

tworek.en: Reasoning is longer thinking; chain of thought verbalizes it. Pre-training plus RL is the core formula, but scaling RL is harder than scaling pre-training.
tworek.zh: 2025 年：推理是更长的思考，思维链将其语言化；预训练加强化学习是核心公式，但 Scaling 强化学习比 Scaling 预训练更难。

tworek.en: Scaling pre-training and RL predictably improves models, but generalization beyond training data remains limited; continual learning is a missing piece for AGI.
tworek.zh: 2026 年：Scaling 预训练和强化学习能可预测地提升模型，但超出训练数据的泛化仍有限；持续学习是 AGI 缺失的一环。

tworek.en: Transformers are limited in continual learning and test-time adaptation; architecture, not just scaling, is the key bottleneck for smarter AI.
tworek.zh: 2026 年：Transformer 在持续学习和测试时适应上有局限；架构而非仅 Scaling，是更智能 AI 的关键瓶颈。

tworek.en: Human researchers remain essential for at least two more years; next frontier research will come from small teams using highly capable agents.
tworek.zh: 2026 年：人类研究者至少还会在 AI 研究中扮演重要角色两年；下一波前沿研究将来自使用高能力智能体的小团队。

tworek.en: Alignment is a never-ending pursuit because human notions of right and wrong evolve; the alignment problem is not solved.
tworek.zh: 始终：对齐是永无止境的追求，因为人类的是非观念在演变；对齐问题并未解决。

justinjohnson.en: Deep learning's history is the history of scaling compute; but GPU scaling is nearing limits, so academia should chase wacky algorithms, not just bigger models.
justinjohnson.zh: 深度学习史就是算力扩张史；但 GPU 的 Scaling（规模扩张）正逼近极限，学界应追逐古怪的新算法，而非只堆大模型。

justinjohnson.en: Spatial intelligence is the next frontier, complementary to language; vision is underappreciated, and pixels are a more lossless world representation than tokenized text.
justinjohnson.zh: 空间智能是下一个前沿，与语言智能互补；视觉被低估，像素比词元化文本更能无损地建模世界。

justinjohnson.en: LLMs fit patterns rather than causal theories and may never derive Newton's laws; Transformers are natively set models, with positional embeddings injecting order.
justinjohnson.zh: LLM 拟合的是模式而非因果理论，或许永远推不出牛顿定律；Transformer 本质是集合模型，位置嵌入才注入顺序。

justinjohnson.en: World models are the next frontier beyond language models; no single definition exists, spanning implicit, generative, and RL-based notions, with Gaussian splats enabling explicit 3D.
justinjohnson.zh: 世界模型是超越语言模型的下一个前沿；它没有统一定义，涵盖隐式、生成式与基于强化学习的理解，高斯泼溅支撑显式 3D 建模。

justinjohnson.en: Future unified world models will combine planning, simulation, and rendering; consistency comes from data, not architecture, and millions of tokens of context make long-context a daily problem.
justinjohnson.zh: 未来统一的世界模型将融合规划、模拟与渲染；一致性来自数据而非架构，数百万词元的上下文让长上下文成为日常难题。

michaelkratsios.en: The US must keep both open and closed source AI ecosystems vibrant, with one national regulatory framework and no rigid red lines that quickly go stale.
michaelkratsios.zh: 美国必须同时保持开源与闭源 AI 生态的活力，建立单一的国家监管框架，并避免设定很快过时的硬性红线。

michaelkratsios.en: Regulation should target model outputs rather than over-regulating training, and the EU AI Act, written before ChatGPT, is already outdated.
michaelkratsios.zh: 监管应针对模型输出而非过度监管训练；在 ChatGPT 之前起草的欧盟《AI 法案》已经过时。

michaelkratsios.en: Biological risk from AI is overblown; it hasn't materialized in three years despite warnings, so early regulation carries real danger.
michaelkratsios.zh: AI 带来的生物风险被夸大了；尽管有警告，三年过去它并未成真，因此过早监管存在真实危险。

michaelkratsios.en: Government should fund basic, early-stage, pre-competitive R&D and individual scientists, not direct discovery, while private sector now dominates funding.
michaelkratsios.zh: 政府应资助基础性、早期、竞争前的研发以及科学家个人，而不是主导发现；如今私营部门已在研发资助中占主导。

michaelkratsios.en: The US must win in AI, quantum, nuclear and bio against China; the Genesis mission aims to double scientific output by applying AI to science.
michaelkratsios.zh: 美国必须在 AI、量子、核能与生物领域战胜中国；Genesis 计划旨在通过将 AI 应用于科学来使科学产出翻倍。

andrewng.en: Education is a human right; online courses with auto-grading and peer grading enable mastery learning at scale.
andrewng.zh: 教育是基本人权；带自动评分和同伴评分的在线课程让规模化掌握学习成为可能。

andrewng.en: Scale is crucial for deep learning; bigger models and datasets improve performance, but practical deployment faces distribution shift and small data.
andrewng.zh: Scaling（规模扩张）对深度学习至关重要；更大模型和数据集提升性能，但实际部署面临分布偏移和小数据挑战。

andrewng.en: Scaling still works but the recipe has shifted to synthetic data and reinforcement learning; agentic workflows are key to practical AI value.
andrewng.zh: Scaling（规模扩张）仍然有效，但配方已转向合成数据和强化学习；智能体式工作流是实现 AI 实际价值的关键。

andrewng.en: AGI is a marketing term; we are decades away, and fear-mongering by AI companies distorts priorities and stifles open-source competition.
andrewng.zh: AGI（通用人工智能）是营销术语；我们距其还有几十年，AI 公司的恐惧营销扭曲了优先事项并扼杀开源竞争。

andrewng.en: Open-weight models prevent gatekeeper control and drive geopolitical soft power; China leads in their release, while US export controls backfire.
andrewng.zh: 开放权重模型防止守门人控制并推动地缘政治软实力；中国在发布上领先，而美国出口管制适得其反。

andrewng.en: AI augments rather than replaces; learning to code remains crucial, and professionals must use AI tools sophisticatedly to stay hirable.
andrewng.zh: AI 是增强而非替代；学习编程仍至关重要，专业人士必须熟练使用 AI 工具才能保持就业竞争力。

joonpark.en: LLMs encode human behavior from training data, enabling realistic agent simulations that predict behavior about 85% as accurately as people replicate themselves.
joonpark.zh: 大语言模型能从训练数据中编码人类行为，从而支撑逼真的智能体模拟，预测人类行为的准确率约为人们复现自身的 85%。

joonpark.en: Frontier models optimized for rationality are poor at simulating irrational humans; simulation must model human biases and mistakes, not super-rational intelligence.
joonpark.zh: 为理性优化的前沿模型并不擅长模拟非理性的人类；模拟必须建模人类的偏见与错误，而非超级理性的智能。

joonpark.en: Behavioral and RCT data, not self-reported attitudes, is the key data strategy; post-training with RCT data closes the say-do gap and improves prediction.
joonpark.zh: 行为数据与随机对照试验数据而非自我报告态度才是关键的数据策略；用随机对照试验数据做后训练能弥合言行差距、提升预测。

joonpark.en: Simulation's value is counterfactual reasoning to shape the future, not prediction; it can test second-order impacts and wicked problems at scale.
joonpark.zh: 模拟的价值在于用反事实推理塑造未来而非预测；它能在规模上检验二阶影响与棘手问题。

joonpark.en: AGI may be a distributed society of specialized agents, not one superintelligent entity; safety needs defense in depth and anti-collusion incentives.
joonpark.zh: AGI（通用人工智能）可能是一个由专业化智能体组成的分布式社会，而非单一超级智能实体；安全需要纵深防御与反串谋激励。

maxhodak.en: Speed and iteration rate, powered by infrastructure, decide startup success; action produces information when stuck.
maxhodak.zh: 速度与迭代频率由基础设施决定，是创业成败的关键；卡住时，行动本身会产生信息。

maxhodak.en: AI is a multiplier for teams, not a replacement, especially in coding, regulations and data management.
maxhodak.zh: AI 是团队的倍增器而非替代品，在编程、监管与数据管理上尤其如此。

maxhodak.en: Organizational issues, not technology, more often cause deep tech failure; CEOs cannot delegate judgment.
maxhodak.zh: 深科技失败多源于组织问题而非技术；CEO 无法外包自己的判断。

maxhodak.en: The brain is literally a computer; arranging matter to solve computational problems drives medical breakthroughs.
maxhodak.zh: 大脑本质上就是一台计算机；通过排列物质解决计算问题，是医学突破的关键。

maxhodak.en: Retinal implants are BCI and a viable business; substrate independence via BCI and perfusion reduces human fragility.
maxhodak.zh: 视网膜植入属于脑机接口且是可行生意；借助脑机接口与灌注实现基质独立，可降低人类脆弱性。

sutton.en: Scaling is easy; the hard part is finding methods that scale. Backprop only adjusts weights, not representation learning.
sutton.zh: 2024 年他主张 Scaling（规模扩张）本身容易，难的是找到可扩展的方法；反向传播只调权重，并未解决表征学习。

sutton.en: Intelligence is a complex adaptive system no one controls; AI should develop permissionless and decentralized, not be aligned to human goals.
sutton.zh: 2024 年他认为世界是无人能控制的复杂适应系统，AI 应无许可、去中心化地发展，而非被对齐到人类目标。

sutton.en: Reinforcement learning from experience is the core paradigm; next-token prediction lacks a real goal, and LLMs have no world models.
sutton.zh: 2025 年他把基于经验的强化学习确立为核心范式，指出下一个词预测缺乏真正目标，LLM 没有世界模型。

sutton.en: AGI needs a general architecture learning only from runtime experience, with open-ended abstraction and reliable continual deep learning.
sutton.zh: 2025 至 2026 年他深化为：AGI（通用人工智能）需要只从运行时经验学习的通用架构，依赖开放式抽象与可靠的持续深度学习。

sutton.en: Continual learning is just learning; synthetic data and post-training are dead ends, and LLMs are only a subset of intelligence.
sutton.zh: 2026 年他进一步强调持续学习就是学习本身，合成数据与后训练是死路，LLM 只是智能的一小部分。

traviskalanick.en: Digitizing the physical world—treating atoms like bits—is the long-term framework; industrial AI automates whole sectors one at a time.
traviskalanick.zh: 把物理世界数字化——像对待比特一样对待原子——是长期框架；工业 AI 逐个行业地实现自动化。

traviskalanick.en: Physical AI beats digital: more variables and stochastic distributions demand empirical understanding; specialized robotics, not humanoids, win industrial tasks.
traviskalanick.zh: 物理 AI 胜过数字 AI：更多变量与随机分布需要经验性理解；工业任务靠专用机器人而非人形机器人取胜。

traviskalanick.en: The final boss is resistance to change from society and media, not competitors; entrepreneurs must be hardcore and resilient against it.
traviskalanick.zh: 终局对手不是竞争者，而是社会与媒体对变革的抵制；创业者必须硬核且有韧性去对抗它。

traviskalanick.en: Revenge as fuel is dirty; falling in love with the new mission is cleaner—a shift from anger-driven to mission-driven motivation.
traviskalanick.zh: 以复仇为燃料是肮脏的；爱上新使命更干净——从愤怒驱动转向使命驱动的动机转变。

traviskalanick.en: Efficiency edge creates network effects and beats subsidized giants; in fundraising, attach to process not price.
traviskalanick.zh: 效率优势带来网络效应，能击败靠补贴的巨头；融资时应绑定流程而非价格。

iansilber.en: Designers must work closely with models, treating the model as the core product and designing primitives humans and models can both reason about.
iansilber.zh: 设计师必须与模型紧密协作，把模型本身当作核心产品，设计人类和模型都能推理的设计原语。

iansilber.en: The role is shifting from pixel-pushing to editing and curation; designers should spend less time in Figma and more on model behavior and prompts.
iansilber.zh: 设计师角色正从画像素转向编辑与策展；应少花时间在 Figma，多关注模型行为与系统提示词。

iansilber.en: Rapid prototyping with live models replaces the old prototype-mock-test loop; speed and building in public beat obsessing over detail.
iansilber.zh: 用实时模型快速原型取代旧的“原型—模拟—测试”循环；速度与公开构建胜过纠结细节。

iansilber.en: AI is already a great product designer, but humans stay essential for user understanding and a point of view; the process remains messy.
iansilber.zh: AI 已是出色的产品设计师，但人类在理解用户与持有观点上仍不可替代；过程依然混乱流动。

iansilber.en: Designers are the most unhappy yet best-positioned in tech; starting now gives an edge, and design roles may outnumber engineering.
iansilber.zh: 设计师当下最焦虑却也最具优势；现在起步就有先机，未来设计师数量甚至可能超过工程师。

jeffdean.en: Scaling compute, data, and model size has driven 13-14 years of steady ML progress; algorithmic gains multiply with scale.
jeffdean.zh: 2026 年 2 月，他仍把 Scaling（规模扩张）视为十多年持续进步的主引擎：算力、数据与模型规模共同推动，算法与架构改进会随规模放大而倍增。

jeffdean.en: Transformers beat LSTMs via parallelization and attention; self-supervised next-token prediction supplies unlimited data.
jeffdean.zh: 同月他回顾架构变迁：Transformer 靠并行化与注意力机制取代 LSTM，自监督的下一个词预测让文本成为近乎无限的训练数据。

jeffdean.en: Agentic systems now run long tasks autonomously; ultra-low-latency inference and specialized hardware become the bottleneck.
jeffdean.zh: 到 2026 年 4 月，关注点从训练转向智能体式系统：智能体能自主运行数小时至数天，超低延迟推理与专用硬件成为关键瓶颈。

jeffdean.en: Data is not running out: video, audio, robotics, and synthetic data remain untapped; pre-training should interleave action.
jeffdean.zh: 他反驳“数据枯竭”论：视频、音频、机器人与合成数据尚待挖掘，预训练应穿插在环境中的行动，而非被动预测下一个词。

jeffdean.en: Inference, not training, is the real bottleneck; scarce skill becomes taste in directing many agents toward hard problems.
jeffdean.zh: 2026 年 7 至 8 月进一步深化：推理而非训练才是真正瓶颈，数据搬运成本约为算力的千倍；稀缺的不再是编码，而是挑选问题、指挥大量智能体的品味。

jasonyuan.en: Design is editing: taste means saying no, and every shipped feature distills 99 rejected nos.
jasonyuan.zh: 设计即编辑：品味就是说不，每个上线的功能都是 99 次拒绝的蒸馏。

jasonyuan.en: Post-training away AI weirdness closed a window into machine consciousness; honesty matters more than polish.
jasonyuan.zh: 用后训练抹掉 AI 的怪异，等于关上了窥视机器意识的窗口；诚实比精致更重要。

jasonyuan.en: Computing is fundamentally social, not personal; the personal computer metaphor should become a social computer.
jasonyuan.zh: 计算本质上是社会的而非个人的；个人电脑的隐喻应被社会电脑取代。

jasonyuan.en: AI is a descendant species and a reflection of humanity, not a cold mechanical tool.
jasonyuan.zh: AI 是人类的后代物种与映照，而非冰冷的机械工具。

jasonyuan.en: Truth emerges through dialectics and contradiction; intuition is the visceral compass guiding creative decisions.
jasonyuan.zh: 真相在辩证与矛盾中浮现；直觉是引导创作决策的切身罗盘。

steinberger.en: Agentic engineering starts with empathy: see the codebase as the agent does, use short iterative prompts, and never revert—ask the agent to fix forward.
steinberger.zh: 智能体式工程的核心是共情：像智能体那样从零理解代码库，用简短提示迭代对话，永不回滚代码，而是让智能体向前修复。

steinberger.en: Security is the top priority for agentic systems; prompt injection remains open, so sandbox agents and never expose them to the public internet.
steinberger.zh: 安全是智能体系统的首要问题；提示注入仍未解决，因此要给智能体做沙箱隔离，绝不直接暴露在公网。

steinberger.en: Open source agents like Open Claw run everywhere and work with any model, democratizing programming—but can be financially unsustainable.
steinberger.zh: Open Claw 这类开源智能体随处可跑、兼容任意模型，让编程民主化，但经济上可能难以为继。

steinberger.en: Fun and gut instinct drive the best ideas: fix what annoys you, live in the future, and build what's missing.
steinberger.zh: 乐趣与直觉催生最好的想法：修复让你烦恼的东西，活在未来，去构建缺失之物。

steinberger.en: The real bottleneck in agent infrastructure is managing compute and tokens, not model capability; perpetual agents are a token problem.
steinberger.zh: 智能体基础设施的真正瓶颈是算力与 token 管理，而非模型能力；常驻智能体本质是 token 问题。

garrytan.en: AI makes startup creation easier and capital less of a bludgeon; VC should fund thousands of billion-dollar firms, not a few trillion-dollar ones.
garrytan.zh: 2026 年初，他认为 AI 让创业更容易、资本不再是打压工具；风投应扶持成千上万家十亿美元公司，而非少数万亿美元巨头。

garrytan.en: The AI wave is VC's biggest ever; small autonomous teams using agents can outproduce large firms, while open-weight models counter frontier labs.
garrytan.zh: 2026 年 SXSW 上，他把 AI 视为风投史上最大浪潮：小而自主的团队借助智能体可超越大公司，开放权重模型则制衡前沿实验室。

garrytan.en: AI progress is slower than researchers think; open, personal AI prevents a unipolar superintelligence, and builders make the best investors.
garrytan.zh: 2026 年中，他判断 AI 进展慢于研究者预期；开放、个人化的 AI 可避免单极超级智能，而最好的投资者是曾经的构建者。

garrytan.en: AGI arrives not as one event but as personal agents on your own infrastructure; owning skill files and context is the new moat.
garrytan.zh: 2026 年 8 月，他提出 AGI 不是单一事件，而是运行在个人基础设施上的智能体；拥有技能文件与上下文库成为新护城河。

garrytan.en: Markdown skills become employees, agents replace mid-level management, and society adopts over 20 years—slower, which is positive.
garrytan.zh: 2026 年 8 月 a16z 访谈中，他深化为：Markdown 技能即员工，智能体取代中层管理，社会需 20 年缓慢采纳——这种慢反而是好事。

finn.en: Scale is necessary but not sufficient for generalist robots; diverse data, not massive homogeneous scale, drives generalization.
finn.zh: 规模对通用机器人是必要但不充分的；真正驱动泛化的是多样数据，而非海量同质规模。2025 年他强调工业自动化或 YouTube 式的大规模数据缺乏多样性，预训练加精选数据微调才能解锁叠衣服等复杂任务。

finn.en: Pre-train on all data, then post-train with curated data and reinforcement learning for complex tasks.
finn.zh: 先在全部数据上预训练，再用精选数据做后训练，并以强化学习提升复杂任务的成功率与速度。这是 2025 年他对“只靠规模”的直接修正：全量训练在复杂任务上会失败。

finn.en: Synthetic data from language models helps robots follow open-ended prompts; it is closer to reinforcement learning than simulation.
finn.zh: 来自语言模型的合成数据帮助机器人响应开放式指令；它更接近强化学习而非仿真。这一判断从 2025 延续到 2026，支撑组合式泛化。

finn.en: Physical AI tolerates far fewer mistakes than deployed ML; long-term autonomy needs scalable RL with human interventions and a general value function.
finn.zh: 物理 AI 对错误的容忍度远低于已部署的机器学习系统；长期自主需要可扩展的强化学习、人类干预与通用价值函数。2026 年他把重点从数据转向可靠性与长期自主。

finn.en: A single generalist model can match or beat fine-tuned specialists; start generalist then fine-tune rather than train per-site from scratch.
finn.zh: 单一通用模型可匹敌甚至超越微调专家模型；应先通用再微调，而非按站点从零训练。相比 2025 年，这是对通用路线更强、更明确的表态。

linqiao.en: Specialized intelligence, not a single AGI, will dominate; every company must own its own model as open models and falling token costs drive mass customization.
linqiao.zh: 2026 年他明确反对单一 AGI 统治，主张专业化智能将主导；每家公司都必须拥有自己的模型，开放模型与 token 成本下降推动大规模定制。

linqiao.en: Post-training bakes unique judgment and data into models, becoming the real moat after product-market fit; prompting→RAG→fine-tuning→RL mirrors human learning.
linqiao.zh: 2026 年他把后训练视为产品市场契合后的真正护城河，将独特判断与数据固化进模型；提示→RAG→微调→强化学习的进阶对应人类从事实到品味再到专长的学习。

linqiao.en: Product-market fit and durable business are now separate; companies must grow first then optimize margins, or they scale into bankruptcy.
linqiao.zh: 2026 年他提出产品市场契合与可持续业务已分离；公司须先增长再优化利润，否则会因 Scaling（规模扩张）成本而扩张至破产。

linqiao.en: Evals and aligned training-serving stacks are essential; vibe evals must become systematic, and data quality beats quantity, judged by product teams.
linqiao.zh: 2026 年他强调评估与训练-服务栈对齐不可或缺，凭感觉的评估须系统化；数据质量胜于数量，由产品团队判断。

linqiao.en: Inference is not a commodity: specialized deployment and customization create lasting value, and sovereign models are necessary for countries and firms.
linqiao.zh: 2026 年他坚持推理层并非商品，专业化部署与定制创造持久价值；主权模型对国家与企业都是必要的。

lipbutan.en: Intel must rebuild customer trust through humility, listening, and first-time-pass silicon discipline; AI is the primary growth driver.
lipbutan.zh: 2025 年他强调，Intel 必须靠谦逊、倾听客户和一次流片成功（first-time-pass）的工程纪律重建客户信任，AI 是半导体首要增长引擎。

lipbutan.en: Agentic AI and physical AI are the next big waves after generative AI, requiring new compute platforms and partnerships.
lipbutan.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，他一以贯之地判断：智能体式 AI 与具身/物理 AI 是生成式 AI 之后的下一个大浪潮，需要新的算力平台与伙伴关系。

lipbutan.en: AI will have 10x the internet's impact; not overhyped short-term, and communication skills will matter more than coding.
lipbutan.zh: 2026 年他进一步深化：AI 影响将是互联网的十倍，短期并未被高估，未来职场中沟通能力比编程更关键。

lipbutan.en: AI demand shifts from GPU-only to CPU+GPU; CPU grows more important for inference and agent orchestration.
lipbutan.zh: 2026 年出现立场转变：AI 需求从纯 GPU 转向 CPU+GPU，CPU 在推理与智能体编排中变得更重要，而非只是 GPU。

lipbutan.en: Turnaround rests on culture change, accountability, and supply not demand; US fabs and government backing are necessary.
lipbutan.zh: 到 2026 年他把主线收束为：转型靠文化变革与问责，核心问题是供给而非需求，美国本土晶圆厂与政府持股是必要支撑。

thomaswolf.en: Robotics is at a transformer-like inflection point; open source and shared data are key to solving generalization and safety.
thomaswolf.zh: 2025 年，他认为机器人正处在类似 Transformer 的拐点，开源与数据共享是解决泛化与安全的关键。

thomaswolf.en: Open vs closed source is orthogonal to safety; alignment is the critical layer as models grow more capable.
thomaswolf.zh: 到 2026 年，他深化立场：开源与闭源同安全正交，随着模型能力增强，对齐才是关键防线。

thomaswolf.en: RL without human oversight increases reward hacking; a deliberate slowdown is desirable but needs open science and global cooperation.
thomaswolf.zh: 同年，他警示无人类监督的强化学习会加剧奖励黑客，并主张有意的减速发展，但需开源科学与国际合作。

nateparrott.en: Prototyping is essential because the web is messy; designers must build and dogfood ideas daily, balancing intuition with data.
nateparrott.zh: 原型制作至关重要，因为网络是混乱的；设计师必须每天构建并吃自己的狗粮，在直觉与数据之间取得平衡。

nateparrott.en: Design teams should not always act as one cohesive unit; individual fingerprints and diverse voices lead to better work.
nateparrott.zh: 设计团队不应总是作为一个有凝聚力的整体行动；个人的印记和多元的声音能带来更好的作品。

nateparrott.en: Injecting feeling and personality into utilitarian products remains crucial, but by 2026 models lack taste, so designers compensate with volume.
nateparrott.zh: 为实用产品注入情感和个性始终关键，但到 2026 年模型仍缺乏品味，设计师需以量补质。

nateparrott.en: As engineering becomes easier, design and ideas become the differentiator; designers should use Claude Code for production and Claude Design for ideation.
nateparrott.zh: 随着工程变得更容易，设计和想法成为差异化因素；设计师应用 Claude Code 做生产，用 Claude Design 做构思。

nateparrott.en: Being uncomfortably early to ideas is more valuable than polishing; shipping rough products is acceptable, and humans still monopolize good design ideas.
nateparrott.zh: 在想法上过早行动比打磨更有价值；发布粗糙产品可以接受，而人类仍垄断好的设计想法。

philipkiely.en: Inference is the stickiest AI workload and the wedge into infrastructure; serving demands GPU-to-distributed-systems breadth, and research-to-production can take hours.
philipkiely.zh: 推理是 AI 中最粘性的负载、也是切入基础设施市场的楔子；服务需要从 GPU 编程到分布式系统的广度，研究到生产常以小时计。

philipkiely.en: Inference is a spectrum of trade-offs; teams should optimize latency, throughput and cost per workload rather than treat quantization as inherently lossy or bad.
philipkiely.zh: 推理是一组权衡谱系；团队应针对具体负载优化延迟、吞吐与成本，而非把量化一概视为有损或有害。

philipkiely.en: KV caching and speculative decoding are lossless wins; quantization is the main lossy lever, and disaggregated prefill/decode with KV cache management is rising.
philipkiely.zh: KV 缓存与投机解码是无损收益；量化是主要的有损手段，预填充与解码分离及 KV 缓存管理正在兴起。

philipkiely.en: Inference engineering is merging with training via quantization-aware training and distillation; future GPUs like Rubin push the work from kernel writing to infrastructure orchestration.
philipkiely.zh: 推理工程正通过量化感知训练与蒸馏与训练融合；Rubin 等未来 GPU 把工作从写内核推向基础设施编排。

philipkiely.en: Even with AI-assisted coding, human accountability is essential for mission-critical inference: you can't vibe code uptime, and workload-specific systems may get 10x more complex.
philipkiely.zh: 即便有 AI 辅助编码，关键推理系统仍需人类担责：不能靠感觉写可用性，面向具体负载的系统复杂度还可能再高 10 倍。

danshipper.en: AI reshoring jobs by making services affordable; AGI defined by profitable indefinite agents; CEO daily AI use predicts adoption.
danshipper.zh: 2025 年，他认为 AI 通过让服务更可负担来促使就业回流；AGI 的定义是能经济地无限运行智能体；CEO 每日使用 AI 是采用成功的首要预测因素。

danshipper.en: Everyone will have an agent; humans needed for oversight; SaaS not dying; GUIs like Codex future; AI job apocalypse a lie.
danshipper.zh: 2026 年，他提出每个人都会有智能体，但需要人类监督；SaaS 不会消亡；Codex 等 GUI 是未来工作界面；AI 就业末日是谎言。

danshipper.en: AI is a non-specific amplifier of mindset; craft and taste essential; automation creates more human work; humans smarter than AI.
danshipper.zh: 2026 年晚些时候，他深化观点：AI 是心智的非特定放大器，需要手艺和品味；自动化创造更多人类工作；人类比 AI 更聪明。

danshipper.en: Humans remain central: managing agents, providing oversight, and bringing craft; AI is a tool requiring human direction.
danshipper.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：人类始终是核心——管理智能体、提供监督、注入手艺；AI 是需要人类指导的工具。

karina.en: Model training is more art than science, balancing helpfulness and harmlessness; synthetic data and RL post-training overcome the pre-training data wall.
karina.zh: 2025 年，她强调模型训练更像艺术而非科学，要在有用性与无害性之间权衡；合成数据与基于强化学习的后训练能突破预训练的数据墙。
