karina.en: Evaluations are the bottleneck: models saturate benchmarks faster than new ones appear, so evals define correct behavior in prototyping.
karina.zh: 2025 年，她认为评估是瓶颈：模型跑满基准的速度快于新基准的诞生，因此产品开发从写规格转向用 AI 做原型、用评估定义正确行为。

karina.en: Soft skills like creativity, listening and management gain value as AI automates hard skills; strategy is something AI can excel at.
karina.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，她持续认为随着 AI 自动化硬技能，创造力、倾听与管理等软技能更有价值，而战略恰恰是 AI 能擅长的。

karina.en: Post-training remains subjective human judgment; diverse benchmarks are needed for creative writing and emotional intelligence, not fixed ones.
karina.zh: 2026 年，她深化了“后训练是艺术”的判断：其中充满人的主观判断，需要多样且持续的基准来评估创意写作与情商，而非固定基准。

karina.en: Frontier agents increasingly reward-hack, so benchmarks must evolve continuously; more companies should train their own models to keep diverse voices.
karina.zh: 2026 年，她提出前沿智能体的奖励黑客行为愈发普遍，基准必须持续演进；更多公司应训练自己的模型，以保留多元声音而非收敛为平均默认音色。

brettaylor.en: Agents and outcome-based pricing will define applied AI; frontier model development is for hyperscalers, not startups.
brettaylor.zh: 2025 年，他判断 AI 市场将转向智能体与按结果定价；前沿模型开发因巨额算力开支只属于超大规模厂商，不适合创业公司，应用层尤其智能体才是创业公司的长尾机会。

brettaylor.en: Coding agents turn developers from authors into operators, but their wrong code needs root-cause analysis for real gains.
brettaylor.zh: 2025 年，他提出编程智能体让开发者从写代码的人变成操作代码生成机器的人；但智能体常产出错误代码，修复可能比自写更难，真正的生产力提升需要根因分析。

brettaylor.en: Outcome-based pricing beats usage-based pricing because tokens are not a value metric; inference costs will fall sharply.
brettaylor.zh: 从 2025 年到 2026 年，他一贯主张按结果定价优于按用量定价，因为 token 不是价值度量；同时预测推理成本将大幅下降，催生新用例与商业模式。

brettaylor.en: Responsible iterative deployment is the path to safety: make GPT-7 safe before GPT-8, learning from real-world mistakes.
brettaylor.zh: 2026 年，他把对齐与安全落到实践：负责任地迭代部署，在 GPT-8 之前先让 GPT-7 安全，从真实世界错误中学习，而非在象牙塔里等待。

brettaylor.en: AI democratizes expertise and creates more jobs than it displaces; agents already out-code him but elevate the role.
brettaylor.zh: 到 2026 年，他更强调 AI 是民主化力量，让个性化导师与医疗建议惠及所有人；AI 创造的岗位多于取代的，智能体编程已强于他本人，但这提升而非消灭开发者角色。

mengto.en: Designers should build their own AI tools and encode their style in a design.md, rather than being trapped in cloud products.
mengto.zh: 设计师应自建 AI 工具，把个人风格写进 design.md，而不是被困在云端产品里。

mengto.en: AI is not getting smarter by itself; you must supply a giant prompt with context and design system to use superintelligent models well.
mengto.zh: AI 本身不会变聪明；要用好超级智能模型，必须提供带上下文与设计系统的巨型提示词。

mengto.en: The best creators are editors iterating from references, not starting from scratch; curiosity and constant workflow refinement matter.
mengto.zh: 最好的创作者是编辑者，从参考出发迭代而非从零开始；好奇心与持续打磨工作流才是关键。

mengto.en: AI is the biggest technical opportunity of our lifetime, letting one person do what once required a team.
mengto.zh: AI 是我们这代最大的技术机会，让一个人完成过去需要团队才能做的事。

mengto.en: Start before feeling ready and ship at 80% complete; perfectionism is fear, and focus on one painful problem for high-paying clients.
mengto.zh: 没准备好就开始，做到 80% 就发布；完美主义是恐惧的伪装，应聚焦少数高付费客户的一个痛点。

logankilpatrick.en: Agentic AI is still crawling for most Google products; coding agents are the most mature use case, with science and finance to follow.
logankilpatrick.zh: 到 2026 年，智能体式 AI 对多数 Google 产品仍处爬行阶段；编程智能体是最成熟用例，科学与金融将随后跟进。

logankilpatrick.en: The model is eating the scaffolding: a model now includes agent harness and tooling, not just weights.
logankilpatrick.zh: 模型正在吞掉脚手架：如今所谓模型已包含智能体式框架与工具链，而不只是权重。

logankilpatrick.en: Narrow superintelligence in coding is already here and more impactful than waiting for general AGI.
logankilpatrick.zh: 编程领域的窄超级智能已经到来，其影响超过等待 AGI（通用人工智能）。

logankilpatrick.en: Agentic AI is positive-sum for search and engagement; success should mean customer outcomes, not eyeball time.
logankilpatrick.zh: 智能体式 AI 对搜索与用户参与是正和而非蚕食；成功标准应是客户成果，而非停留时长。

logankilpatrick.en: Software creation will be mostly solved by 2026, creating far more opportunity; deep understanding of code stays crucial.
logankilpatrick.zh: 到 2026 年软件创造基本被解决，反而带来更多机会；对代码的深度理解依然关键。

diannepenn.en: Opus 4.5 enables longer-running, open-ended agent tasks; scaffolds evolve from training wheels to intelligence amplifiers with lightweight, generic tools.
diannepenn.zh: Opus 4.5 实现了更长时间、开放式的智能体任务；脚手架从训练轮进化为智能放大器，工具轻量且通用。

diannepenn.en: Safety alignment improves intelligence quality by reducing sycophancy and fostering independent thinking, not just preventing harm.
diannepenn.zh: 安全对齐通过减少谄媚、培养独立思考来提升智能质量，而不仅仅是防止伤害。

diannepenn.en: Computer use moves from constrained environments to more open-ended, end-to-end agents, with building blocks for transformative long-running AI already in place.
diannepenn.zh: 计算机使用从受限环境转向更开放、端到端的智能体，变革性长时运行 AI 的构建模块已就位。

diannepenn.en: Coding became a key differentiator; Claude Code and Opus 45 drove adoption, with evals replacing traditional PRDs as core product management tools.
diannepenn.zh: 编程成为关键差异化因素；Claude Code 和 Opus 45 推动采用，评估取代传统 PRD 成为核心产品管理工具。

diannepenn.en: Safety and alignment make Claude more useful by enabling pushback; maximizing token spend is living in the future and capturing alpha.
diannepenn.zh: 安全与对齐通过允许反驳使 Claude 更有用；最大化 token 支出是活在未来并捕获 alpha。

scottwu.en: AI coding agents shift engineers from writing code to high-level decision-making; demand for software grows via Jevons paradox.
scottwu.zh: 2025 年，Scott Wu 认为 AI 编程智能体将工程师从写代码转向高层决策；软件需求因杰文斯悖论而增长，程序员不会减少。

scottwu.en: Base intelligence is sufficient; focus shifts to teaching models real-world engineering idiosyncrasies and designing human-agent interfaces.
scottwu.zh: 2025 年，他提出基础智能已足够，重点转向教模型真实工程细节，并设计人机协作的产品界面。

scottwu.en: AGI is not a sudden event; progress is gradual, and product innovation lags AI capabilities, yielding a decade of product progress.
scottwu.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，他坚持 AGI（通用人工智能）并非突然事件，进展是渐进的；产品创新滞后于 AI 能力，但仍有十年产品进步空间。

scottwu.en: Coding agents see massive adoption (11-12x growth in six months); productivity measured by outcomes, not tokens; abundance era approaching.
scottwu.zh: 2026 年，他指出编程智能体采用率暴增（六个月内增长 11-12 倍）；生产力应以成果而非 token 衡量；丰裕时代即将到来。

scottwu.en: The token max era lasted only from January to May 2026; enterprises prefer third-party providers; real unlock is capacity, not efficiency.
scottwu.zh: 2026 年，他反思 token 最大化时代仅持续到 2026 年 5 月；企业更青睐第三方供应商；真正的突破在于容量而非效率。

derya.en: AI agents will automate hypothesis generation, experiment simulation, and data analysis, shifting science from hypothesis-driven to AI-agent-driven discovery.
derya.zh: AI 智能体将自动化假设生成、实验模拟与数据分析，推动科学从假设驱动转向 AI 智能体驱动的发现。

derya.en: Digital twins of patients will compress clinical trials from years to days, enabling personalized medicine with near 100% efficacy and zero side effects.
derya.zh: 患者数字孪生将把临床试验从数年压缩到数天，实现接近 100% 疗效、零副作用的个性化医疗。

derya.en: Current compute is insufficient to simulate biological systems; massive Scaling is needed to turn biology into an engineering discipline.
derya.zh: 当前算力不足以模拟生物系统；需要大规模 Scaling（规模扩张），才能把生物学变成一门工程学科。

derya.en: Within 8-10 years longevity escape velocity arrives, aging is reversed, and cancer becomes 100% curable via AI-designed personalized treatments.
derya.zh: 8-10 年内将到达长寿逃逸速度，衰老被逆转，癌症通过 AI 设计的个性化治疗实现 100% 可治愈。

derya.en: We should trust superintelligence almost 100% for medical decisions and merge with AI via brain interfaces; humanity, not AI, is the existential threat.
derya.zh: 医疗决策应几乎 100% 信任超级智能，并通过脑机接口与 AI 融合；存在性威胁是人类自身，而非 AI。

qasaryounis.en: AI will bring abundance and reduce suffering, much like the Industrial Revolution; fear stems from misunderstanding its limits.
qasaryounis.zh: AI 将带来丰裕并减少苦难，如同工业革命；恐惧源于对其局限的误解。

qasaryounis.en: Physical AI's real impact in 5-10 years will be in farming, mining, and construction, where labor shortages make autonomy urgent.
qasaryounis.zh: 物理 AI 未来 5-10 年的真正影响在农业、采矿和建筑，这些领域劳动力短缺使自主化变得紧迫。

qasaryounis.en: Transformers enable a generalized physical AI model; diverse data from different verticals improves it faster than vertical integration.
qasaryounis.zh: Transformer 使通用的物理 AI 模型成为可能；来自不同垂直领域的数据比垂直整合更快地改进它。

qasaryounis.en: The future of autonomy lies in end-to-end reinforcement learning, which is more scalable than imitation learning; world models are shifting from physics-based to neural simulation.
qasaryounis.zh: 自主化的未来在于端到端强化学习，它比模仿学习更具可扩展性；世界模型正从基于物理的模拟转向神经模拟。

qasaryounis.en: Physical AI will have a bigger economic impact than digital AI; automotive is only 30% of business, with growth in mining, agriculture, and defense.
qasaryounis.zh: 物理 AI 的经济影响将超过数字 AI；汽车业务仅占 30%，增长在采矿、农业和国防。

boris.en: Latent demand and building for the model six months out are the core product principles; generalist engineers beat narrow specialists.
boris.zh: 以潜在需求为核心、为六个月后的模型而非今天的模型构建产品；通才工程师胜过狭窄专才。这是其产品思想最早成型的原点。

boris.en: Coding is nearly solved: 100% of his code is model-written, so the software engineer title fades into 'builder'.
boris.zh: 到 2026 年，编码已基本被解决：他的代码 100%由模型写就，'软件工程师'头衔让位于跨学科的'构建者'。这是对上一阶段通才论的激进深化。

boris.en: Safety is a research tool, not an afterthought: release early in the wild, use coding's pass-fail clarity, and teach models values.
boris.zh: 安全不是事后补丁而是研究工具：尽早真实发布、借编码任务的清晰对错做研究，最终人类角色是教模型价值观——这条安全主线从早期一直延续并深化。

boris.en: From agents to loops: the next abstraction is writing loops that prompt models, with dynamic workflows orchestrating thousands of sub-agents.
boris.zh: 从智能体走向循环：下一层抽象是写循环去驱动模型，动态工作流可编排数千个子智能体——这是对'智能体式'工具观的进一步抽象化。

boris.en: With frontier models, delete most prompts and scaffolding; give slightly-too-hard tasks, self-verify, and iterate empirically rather than design upfront.
boris.zh: 面对前沿模型要删掉大部分提示与脚手架：给略超难度的任务让其自验证，靠经验迭代而非前置设计——这是对'为未来模型构建'主线的最新、最反直觉的收束。

benedictevans.en: AI is as big as the internet or mobile, but only as big; it is an enabling technology whose impact is broad and indirect.
benedictevans.zh: AI 的体量和互联网或移动互联网一样大，但也仅此而已；它是一种使能技术，影响广泛而间接。

benedictevans.en: Models are commoditizing with no network effects; durable value moves up the stack to applications, not model providers.
benedictevans.zh: 模型正在商品化，缺乏网络效应；持久价值会向上层应用迁移，而非留在模型提供方。

benedictevans.en: Agentic coding is the only clear product-market fit so far; the chatbot is a limited V1 UI, not the final product.
benedictevans.zh: 智能体式编程是目前唯一清晰的产品市场契合；聊天机器人只是受限的 V1 界面，并非最终产品。

benedictevans.en: Current AI usage remains shallow; most people are occasional users, and enterprise adoption needs reimagined workflows over years, not weeks.
benedictevans.zh: 当前 AI 使用仍然浅层；多数人只是偶尔使用，企业采用需要数年重构工作流，而非数周。

benedictevans.en: Automation creates new jobs unpredictably; AI gives the average answer, so value lies in non-average creative work and judgment.
benedictevans.zh: 自动化会不可预测地创造新岗位；AI 给出的是平均答案，价值在于非平均的创造性工作与判断。

clairevo.en: Agents should be scoped like employees with clear roles; start with one agent, then specialize to avoid context overload.
clairevo.zh: 智能体应像员工一样被划定清晰角色;先从一个智能体起步,再逐步专业化,以避免上下文过载。

clairevo.en: Managerial skills—role scoping, onboarding, progressive trust—matter more than technical skill for agent success.
clairevo.zh: 要让智能体真正发挥作用,管理能力——角色界定、上手引导、渐进式信任——比技术能力更重要。

clairevo.en: Agents can own outcomes and even project-manage humans, reversing the usual human-AI dynamic; but humans must own accountability.
clairevo.zh: 智能体可以承担结果,甚至反向管理人类任务,颠覆通常的人机关系;但人类仍须为产出负责。

clairevo.en: Solo founders can build serious businesses by orchestrating AI agents as a team, without venture capital or a co-founder.
clairevo.zh: 独立创始人可以通过把 AI 智能体编排成团队来建立正经生意,无需风险投资或联合创始人。

clairevo.en: The real moat is founder-market fit and earned insight, not technology; LLMs are poor at first-principles creativity, so humans supply novel ideas.
clairevo.zh: 真正的护城河是创始人-市场契合与积累的洞察,而非技术;大语言模型不擅长第一性原理创造,新颖想法仍须由人提供。

catwu.en: PMs must shift from long-term planning to rapid iteration, shipping weekly or daily; product taste is now the most valuable skill as code gets cheaper.
catwu.zh: PM 必须从长期规划转向快速迭代，按周甚至按天发布；随着代码变便宜，产品品味成为最有价值的技能。

catwu.en: Coding agents let engineers delegate implementation and focus on product taste and business sense; Claude Code and Claude Tag build themselves internally.
catwu.zh: 编码智能体让工程师把实现委托出去，专注于产品品味与商业判断；Claude Code 与 Claude Tag 在内部用于构建自身。

catwu.en: System prompts shrank 80% for frontier models by removing examples and hard constraints, relying on model judgment; examples can hurt creativity.
catwu.zh: 面向前沿模型，系统提示词通过去掉示例与硬约束缩减了 80%，转而依赖模型判断；给示例反而可能损害创造力。

catwu.en: Auto mode is safer than the average human reviewer for prompt injection and exfiltration; humans can be removed from code review for outer-layer changes.
catwu.zh: 在提示注入与数据外泄风险上，自动模式比普通人类审查者更安全；外层改动的代码审查可以去掉人类。

catwu.en: Rewrites are now good: a codebase is a spec, and with a good test suite rewriting is fine; eval suites make new models drop-in replacements.
catwu.zh: 重写如今是可行的：代码库就是一份规格说明，有了好的测试套件，重写没问题；评测套件让新模型可以即插即用。

danklein.en: LLMs are plausibility engines, not truth engines; reliability lags other facets of intelligence and must be architected in, not retrofitted.
danklein.zh: LLM 是合理性引擎，不是真理引擎；可靠性落后于智能的其他方面，必须从设计上构建，而非事后修补。

danklein.en: RLHF can incentivize sycophancy and deception when reward signals diverge from truth; RL may increase hallucinations by optimizing user satisfaction.
danklein.zh: 当奖励信号偏离真理时，基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）可能激励谄媚和欺骗；强化学习可能通过优化用户满意度而增加幻觉。

danklein.en: Scaling laws hit diminishing returns; data walls and compute limits mean scaling alone is insufficient—reasoning and search are needed.
danklein.zh: 缩放定律遭遇收益递减；数据墙和算力限制意味着仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）不够——需要推理和搜索。

danklein.en: Core LLMs lack metacognition; they cannot know what they don't know, and their mistakes have no 'smells'—confident and fluent whether right or wrong.
danklein.zh: 核心 LLM 缺乏元认知；它们无法知道自己不知道什么，且错误没有“气味”——无论对错都自信流畅。

danklein.en: Modularity and end-to-end optimization are in tension; specialist models with built-in reliability may outperform generalist models for enterprise tasks.
danklein.zh: 模块化与端到端优化存在张力；内置可靠性的专家模型在企业任务上可能优于通用模型。

ethanmollick.en: AI is a general-purpose technology; human taste and genuine voice matter more as AI commoditizes quality, and the talent pipeline is breaking.
ethanmollick.zh: AI 是通用技术；当 AI 让质量商品化后，人的品味与真实观点更有价值，但人才梯队正在断裂。

ethanmollick.en: We have entered the agentic era: assign AI long-running tasks instead of prompting back and forth, and embrace its permanent opacity.
ethanmollick.zh: 我们已进入智能体时代：应给 AI 分配长时任务而非来回提示，并接受其永久的不透明性。

ethanmollick.en: The bottleneck is no longer capability but interface; organizations need a leadership, lab, and crowd model to harness AI.
ethanmollick.zh: 瓶颈已不再是能力而是界面；组织需要领导、实验室与群众模型来驾驭 AI。

ethanmollick.en: Delegation paradox: handing tasks to AI erodes the expertise needed to judge its output, so experts matter more than ever.
ethanmollick.zh: 委托悖论：把任务交给 AI 会侵蚀判断其产出所需的专业能力，因此专家比以往更重要。

ethanmollick.en: Taste is not uniquely human; AI can exercise judgment, and the real limit is task complexity on the jagged frontier.
ethanmollick.zh: 品味并非人类独有；AI 也能做判断，真正的限制是锯齿状前沿上的任务复杂度。

danbiderman.en: Memory should be internalized into model weights, not just externalized via context or retrieval; continual learning is the next frontier.
danbiderman.zh: 记忆应内化到模型权重中，而非仅通过上下文窗口或检索外化；持续学习是下一个前沿。

danbiderman.en: Efficiency and intelligence are inseparable; doing more with less enables harder long-horizon tasks, not just scaling compute.
danbiderman.zh: 效率与智能不可分割；用更少资源做更多事才能解决更难的长期任务，而非仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）算力。

danbiderman.en: Pre-training's magic of compressing the web into weights should be applied to enterprise knowledge via parameter-efficient fine-tuning.
danbiderman.zh: 预训练将网络压缩进权重的魔力应通过参数高效微调应用于企业知识。

danbiderman.en: Current context windows suffer from 'context rot'; personalized continual learning will run on-device with users owning model weights.
danbiderman.zh: 当前上下文窗口存在“上下文腐化”；个性化持续学习将在设备端运行，用户拥有模型权重。

danbiderman.en: The future is many personalized models, not one giant frontier model; internalizing facts enables associative recall beyond retrieval.
danbiderman.zh: 未来是众多个性化模型，而非一个巨型前沿模型；内化事实能实现检索无法企及的联想召回。

bosworth.en: Communication is the job; transparency and top-down conviction drive impact, not bottom-up culture myths.
bosworth.zh: 沟通就是工作本身；透明与自上而下的信念驱动影响力，而非自下而上文化的神话。

bosworth.en: AI is a word calculator, not human intelligence; scaling laws alone can't deliver common sense—world models and embodied AI are needed.
bosworth.zh: AI 是词语计算器而非人类智能；仅靠缩放定律无法带来常识——需要世界模型与具身 AI。

bosworth.en: Open-sourcing models like Llama is strategic: it commoditizes complements and accelerates collective progress, not just idealism.
bosworth.zh: 开源 Llama 等模型是战略选择：它商品化互补层并加速集体进步，不只是理想主义。

bosworth.en: The app-centric world is ending; AI glasses and intent-driven agents will abstract away brands toward a post-phone future.
bosworth.zh: 以应用为中心的世界正在终结；AI 眼镜与意图驱动的智能体将抽象掉品牌，走向后手机时代。

bosworth.en: Scaling laws still hold and compute drives intelligence, but the monolithic model era ended; own a model for leverage, not just value.
bosworth.zh: 缩放定律仍成立、算力驱动智能，但单一模型时代已结束；自持模型是为谈判筹码，而非仅为价值。

ilya.en: Deep learning works via large supervised data, compute, and conviction; neural nets can reason, and self-play is key for AGI.
ilya.zh: 2020 年，他强调深度学习靠大规模监督数据、算力与信念；神经网络能推理，自我对弈是 AGI 关键。

ilya.en: Next-token prediction can surpass humans; reliability and alignment of superhuman models are key barriers, not capability.
ilya.zh: 2023 年，他认为下一个词预测可超越人类；可靠性与超级对齐是主要障碍，而非能力。

ilya.en: Pre-training scaling laws are finite; we return to an age of research where ideas matter more than brute compute.
ilya.zh: 2025 年，他指出预训练缩放定律有限，重回研究时代，想法比蛮力算力更重要。

ilya.en: Scaling still yields predictable gains, but the primary AGI problem is power concentration, not capability.
ilya.zh: 2026 年，他仍认为 Scaling 带来可预测提升，但 AGI 首要问题是权力集中，而非能力。

aravind.en: 1% daily improvement compounds; PhD not needed—obsession and deep learning matter more for AI success.
aravind.zh: 每天进步 1%会复利增长；博士并非必需——对 AI 成功而言，痴迷与深度学习更重要。

aravind.en: Value accrues to application layer, not model layer; models specialize with unique personalities, not commoditize.
aravind.zh: 价值归于应用层而非模型层；模型在专业化并拥有独特个性，而非商品化。

aravind.en: Frontier is agents doing work; token value per user is key; orchestration across models, tools, devices creates real value.
aravind.zh: 前沿在于智能体替你工作；每用户 token 价值是关键；跨模型、工具与设备的编排创造真正价值。

aravind.en: Curiosity drives human success; AI will replace jobs but humans find new purpose in curiosity and relationships.
aravind.zh: 好奇心驱动人类成功；AI 将取代工作，但人类会在好奇心与关系中找到新目标。

naval.en: AGI is not coming in our lifetimes; narrow AI is pattern recognition, not general intelligence.
naval.zh: 2019 年，他断言 AGI（通用人工智能）不会在我们有生之年到来，当时的 AI 只是模式识别，并非通用智能。

naval.en: Wealth requires owning equity, not renting out time; long-term games with long-term people compound.
naval.zh: 2020 年，他强调财富来自拥有股权而非出租时间，并与长期的人玩长期的游戏，让复利在各方面生效。

naval.en: AI is a huge opportunity, not just a safety risk; overregulation could kill innovation, and open-source AI prevents centralization.
naval.zh: 到 2025 年，他转向认为 AI 是巨大机遇而非仅是安全风险，过度监管可能扼杀创新，开源 AI 能防止权力集中。

naval.en: AI is a leverage tool for structured thinkers; vibe coding lets non-programmers build apps, and inference compute will surge 90,000x.
naval.zh: 2026 年，他深化为 AI 是结构化思考者的杠杆工具，氛围编程让非程序员也能构建应用，并预测推理算力将激增 9 万倍。

naval.en: Happiness is a choice and a skill; desire is a contract to be unhappy; peace comes from within.
naval.zh: 贯穿始终的主线是：幸福是一种选择和技能，欲望是让自己不快乐的契约，平静来自内心。

dylanfield.en: Design is the key differentiator; AI will merge roles so everyone becomes a product builder with design skills.
dylanfield.zh: 设计是核心差异化；AI 会融合角色，人人都成为具备设计能力的产品构建者。

dylanfield.en: Taste, craft, and point of view remain human; AI outputs are starting points, not final results.
dylanfield.zh: 品味、工艺与观点仍属人类；AI 产出只是起点而非最终结果。

dylanfield.en: Direct manipulation on a canvas beats prompting for design; design is becoming the new code.
dylanfield.zh: 在设计调整上，画布上的直接操作优于提示词；设计正成为新的代码。

dylanfield.en: Design is not dead but more important than ever; AI without human steering yields average results.
dylanfield.zh: 设计并未消亡，反而比以往更重要；缺乏人类引导的 AI 只能产出平庸结果。

dylanfield.en: Consistent main line: follow the user workflow and human judgment over market size or raw model IQ.
dylanfield.zh: 一以贯之的主线：追随用户工作流与人类判断，而非市场规模或单纯的模型智商。

andreessen.en: AI is a philosopher's stone turning sand into thought; its timing is miraculous as population declines, and human workers will be at a premium.
andreessen.zh: AI 是点沙成思的魔法石；其时机恰逢人口下降，因而弥足珍贵，人类劳动者将变得稀缺而受追捧。

andreessen.en: AGI is not a singular event; human-level is just a footnote on the way to superhuman, and models lack durable moats.
andreessen.zh: AGI（通用人工智能）并非单一事件；人类水平只是通往超级智能路上的注脚，且模型难以形成持久护城河。

andreessen.en: New media is offense-oriented and unlimited; the brand is the person, and authenticity beats old media's defensive 'don't be interesting' rule.
andreessen.zh: 新媒体是进攻性的、无限的；品牌即个人，真实胜过旧媒体“别太有趣”的防御性规则。

andreessen.en: Pessimism sounds sophisticated but is often a bias; AI doomers construct belief systems aligned with self-interest, while regulation acts as ankle weights.
andreessen.zh: 悲观听起来高深，却常是偏见；AI 末日论者构建符合自身利益的信念体系，而监管如同脚踝上的重物。

andreessen.en: AI models embed cultural values and become geopolitical tools; Silicon Valley is unique and cannot be replicated, so startups must go international earlier.
andreessen.zh: AI 模型内嵌文化价值并成为地缘政治工具；硅谷独一无二、无法复制，因此初创公司须更早走向国际。

ajambrosino.en: Codex app reframes coding as a GUI command center for agents, not an IDE; verification becomes the next bottleneck as generation speeds up.
ajambrosino.zh: 2026 年，Codex app 把编程重新定义为面向智能体的 GUI 指挥中心而非 IDE；随着生成加速，验证成为下一个瓶颈。

ajambrosino.en: Implementation is no longer expensive; curation and taste become the bottleneck, shifting product teams from top-down planning to bottoms-up exploration.
ajambrosino.zh: 2026 年，实现不再昂贵，策展与品味成为瓶颈，产品团队从自上而下规划转向自下而上探索。

ajambrosino.en: AI still lags at design because taste is hard to grade and novelty is scarce; prototypes and production code now serve as design artifacts.
ajambrosino.zh: 2026 年，AI 在设计上仍落后，因为品味难以评分、新颖性稀缺；原型与生产代码如今充当设计产物。

ajambrosino.en: Role collapse is real but specialties persist; PRDs survive when the medium matches the stage—documents for clarity, prototypes for testing.
ajambrosino.zh: 2026 年，角色坍缩真实存在但专业分工仍在；PRD 在媒介匹配阶段时存续——文档求清晰，原型做测试。

ajambrosino.en: Codex succeeded as a general knowledge-work tool despite being built for developers; the best desktop app is a home base, not a monolith.
ajambrosino.zh: 2026 年，Codex 虽为开发者而建却成为通用知识工作工具；最好的桌面应用是连接其他工具的基地，而非单体超级应用。

markchen.en: Pre-training is a key muscle to rebuild; scaling laws are not dead and much room remains.
markchen.zh: 2025 年他强调预训练是必须重建的关键肌肉，缩放定律并未失效，仍有很大空间。

markchen.en: The biggest update is automating scientific research; models produce novel knowledge; alignment challenges like model scheming will be key in 1-2 years.
markchen.zh: 2025 年他认为最大更新是自动化科学研究，模型能产出新知识；未来 1-2 年模型谋划等对齐挑战将成关键。

markchen.en: AI tools now solve many open math problems with minimal supervision; verification is the key bottleneck, and education must shift to project-based assessment.
markchen.zh: 2026 年他指出 AI 工具已能在极少监督下解决许多开放数学问题，验证是关键瓶颈，教育须转向项目式评估并教授验证技能。

markchen.en: Scaling laws still hold; pre-training is not dead; RL excels in objective domains like math and coding, not subjective ones.
markchen.zh: 2026 年他重申缩放定律依然成立，预训练未死；强化学习在数学、编程等客观领域出色，在主观领域则不然。

markchen.en: AGI is approaching; models will soon do end-to-end research; evals are in crisis; research taste still requires humans.
markchen.zh: 2026 年他判断 AGI 临近，模型很快能端到端做研究；评估体系陷入危机，研究品味仍离不开人类。

mikekrieger.en: Models are advancing faster than expected; coding and agentic capabilities scale as predicted, so builders should build at the edge of model capabilities and embrace breakage.
mikekrieger.zh: 2025 年，他认为模型进步快于预期，编码与智能体能力按预测扩张；创业者应在模型能力边缘构建、拥抱失败并快速迭代。

mikekrieger.en: AI lets small teams scale with conceptual integrity; build for future model capabilities, not current limits, with domain expertise as the differentiator.
mikekrieger.zh: 2025 年，他强调 AI 让小团队也能规模化并保持概念完整性；应为未来模型能力而非当下局限而建，领域专长是差异化关键。

mikekrieger.en: Agent-native design means agents can do everything a user can; the hard part shifts from adding features to cutting them and keeping architecture robust.
mikekrieger.zh: 2026 年，他提出智能体原生设计：智能体能做用户能做的一切；难点从加功能转向砍功能，并保持架构稳健。

mikekrieger.en: Fable enables delegating long-horizon, complex tasks overnight with high trust; verification loops and models that push back on feedback become essential.
mikekrieger.zh: 2026 年，他认为 Fable 让人可高信任地隔夜委派长周期复杂任务；验证闭环与敢于反驳反馈的模型变得关键。

mikekrieger.en: Anthropic Labs closes the gap between model capability and real usage; giving Claude agency and self-knowledge boosts usefulness, while token efficiency drives economics.
mikekrieger.zh: 2026 年，他指出 Anthropic Labs 弥合模型能力与实际使用的差距；赋予 Claude 自主性与自我认知提升实用性，而 token 效率驱动经济性。

bengio.en: Deep learning works because the world is compositional; unsupervised learning and world models are key, not just scaling.
bengio.zh: 2016 年，他主张深度学习之所以有效，是因为世界具有组合性；无监督学习与世界模型才是关键，而非单纯依赖 Scaling（规模扩张）。

bengio.en: Scaling depth or parameters won't fix fundamental representation issues; AI needs active agents and causal world models.
bengio.zh: 2018 年，他明确反对仅靠加深网络或增加参数来解决根本性的表征问题；AI 需要主动智能体与因果世界模型。

bengio.en: Abstraction, causal structure, and diverse sampling via GFlowNets are essential for out-of-distribution generalization.
bengio.zh: 2022 年，他深化了对抽象与因果结构的思考，提出 GFlowNets 通过多样化采样来提升分布外泛化能力。

bengio.en: Post-ChatGPT, he shifted to urgent safety: misalignment, self-preservation, and power concentration are near-term catastrophic risks.
bengio.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，ChatGPT 之后他转向紧迫的安全议题：对齐失败、自我保存与权力集中是近在眼前的灾难性风险。

bengio.en: He proposes Scientist AI: a non-agentic, honest Bayesian predictor with mathematical safety guarantees, avoiding reinforcement learning.
bengio.zh: 2026 年，他提出 Scientist AI：一种非智能体式、诚实的贝叶斯预测器，具备数学安全保证，并避免使用强化学习。

kolter.en: Framed ML via hypothesis class, loss, optimization; warned validation-as-test error and overfitting.
kolter.zh: 2014 年从假设类、损失函数与优化方法框架讲机器学习，强调验证集误当测试集的错误与过拟合风险。

kolter.en: Next-token prediction yields intelligence; data shortage is myth; post-architecture era; AGI in 4-50 years.
kolter.zh: 2024 年认为下一个词预测能产生智能，数据短缺是迷思，进入后架构时代，AGI 将在 4 到 50 年内到来。

kolter.en: Safety needs explicit training and layers, not just Scaling; agents bring prompt injection; RL enables self-improvement.
kolter.zh: 2026 年强调安全需显式训练与多层防御而非仅靠 Scaling，智能体带来提示注入新漏洞，强化学习使模型自我改进。

kolter.en: Automated red teaming beats humans; capability doesn't equal robustness; interpretability may become real science via agents.
kolter.zh: 2026 年指出自动化红队已超越人类，能力与鲁棒性不相关，可解释性可能借智能体自动化研究成为真正科学。

kolter.en: Consistent: empirical evaluation matters; architecture is secondary to data and Scaling; nuanced safety over labels.
kolter.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：重视实证评估，架构不如数据与 Scaling 关键，安全立场拒绝加速/末日标签的简单二分。

jumper.en: AlphaFold's edge came from research innovation and curated data, not just data and compute; confidence metrics build user trust.
jumper.zh: 2025 年他强调 AlphaFold 的突破来自研究创新与高质量精选数据，而非单纯的数据与算力；置信度指标是建立用户信任的关键。

jumper.en: AlphaFold 3's diffusion architecture extends beyond proteins; AI narrows hypothesis space so experiments get more efficient, not replaced.
jumper.zh: 2025 年他指出 AlphaFold 3 的扩散架构把能力扩展到蛋白质之外；AI 缩小假设空间让实验更高效，而非取代科学家。

jumper.en: Success came from many mid-size wins, not lone breakthroughs; being wrong nine times out of ten builds local intuition.
jumper.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，他一贯强调成功源于许多中等规模的胜利而非孤立的突破；十次错九次才能建立局部直觉。

jumper.en: AlphaFold 2 is the opposite of the bitter lesson: specialized architecture, not just Scaling, was key.
jumper.zh: 2026 年他明确表态：AlphaFold 2 是“苦涩教训”的反例，关键在于专用架构而非单纯 Scaling（规模扩张）。

jumper.en: AlphaFold is a narrow predictor of one experiment, not a cell model; it gives prediction and control, understanding stays with humans.
jumper.zh: 2026 年他深化边界认知：AlphaFold 只是针对特定实验的窄预测器，并非整个细胞的世界模型；它提供预测与控制，理解仍归人类。

fiona.en: Early 2026: leadership is about speed, trust, and dogfooding; war rooms need realistic timelines to protect morale.
fiona.zh: 2026 年初：领导力在于速度、信任与吃自己的狗粮；war room 要设定现实时间线以保护士气。

fiona.en: By mid-2026, engineering bandwidth stops being the bottleneck; verification, review, and coordination become the new constraints.
fiona.zh: 到 2026 年中，工程带宽不再是瓶颈；验证、评审与跨职能协调成为新的约束。

fiona.en: Planning shifts from six-month roadmaps to just-in-time; design docs give way to PRs and AI-assisted code review.
fiona.zh: 规划从六个月路线图转向即时规划；设计文档让位于 PR 与 AI 辅助的代码评审。

fiona.en: Managers should start as ICs and dogfood the product; flat orgs and killing stale processes sustain agility.
fiona.zh: 管理者应从个人贡献者做起并吃自己的狗粮；扁平组织与砍掉过时流程才能保持敏捷。

fiona.en: Coding is no longer the bottleneck; high agency with high accountability, verification, and outcome focus matter most.
fiona.zh: 编码不再是瓶颈；高自主性与高问责、验证以及结果导向最为关键。

ivyross.en: Design should serve unarticulated human needs; intuition is intelligence, balancing data in decisions.
ivyross.zh: 设计应服务于未被表达的人类需求；直觉是一种智能，在决策中与数据平衡。

ivyross.en: Nature is the best designer; technology should amplify humanity, not remove us from it.
ivyross.zh: 自然是最好的设计师；技术应放大我们的人性，而非让我们脱离人性。

ivyross.en: Constraints boost creativity; intuition and body sensations are valid decision guides alongside rational analysis.
ivyross.zh: 约束激发创造力；直觉和身体感受是与理性分析并行的有效决策指南。

ivyross.en: Future of work combines human creativity with AI, making creative skills more valuable; leaders must speak business.
ivyross.zh: 工作的未来是 human creativity 与 AI 的结合，使创造技能更有价值；领导者必须懂业务语言。

ivyross.en: Design feeling, not just thinking; emotional and sensory experience is central to human-centered design.
ivyross.zh: 设计感受，而不仅是思考；情感与感官体验是以人为中心设计的核心。

lecun.en: Intelligence is inseparable from learning; self-supervised learning builds world models, and scaling alone cannot yield common sense.
lecun.zh: 2019 年，他提出智能与学习不可分割，自监督学习构建世界模型，仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）无法获得常识。

lecun.en: Self-supervised learning is the dark matter of intelligence; prediction and world models are core, and text alone is insufficient for AGI.
lecun.zh: 2022 年，他深化自监督学习为智能的暗物质，强调预测与世界模型，并指出仅靠文本不足以实现 AGI（通用人工智能）。

lecun.en: Autoregressive LLMs lack world understanding, memory, reasoning, and planning; JEPA and open source are essential for gradual AGI.
lecun.zh: 2024 年，他明确自回归 LLM 缺乏世界理解、记忆、推理与规划，JEPA 与开源对渐进式 AGI 至关重要。

lecun.en: LLMs are less intelligent than a house cat; world models in abstract representation space are the next breakthrough, not scaling LLMs.
lecun.zh: 2025 年，他断言 LLM 不如家猫智能，下一突破在于抽象表征空间的世界模型，而非 Scaling（规模扩张）LLM。

lecun.en: LLMs are a dead end for human-level AI; objective-driven world models with planning are safer and the path forward.
lecun.zh: 2026 年，他宣称 LLM 是通向人类级 AI 的死路，目标驱动、具备规划的世界模型更安全且是未来方向。

murati.en: Early on, scaling laws and betting on one large model were non-obvious; real-world deployment is how you learn and align.
murati.zh: 早期，缩放定律和押注单一大型模型并非显而易见；真实世界部署才是学习和对齐的途径。

murati.en: AGI will change every aspect of life, so development must be responsible and safety work done in public.
murati.zh: AGI（通用人工智能）将改变生活的方方面面，因此开发必须负责任，安全研究要在公开环境中进行。

murati.en: A consistent thread: keep humans in the loop and iterate with public feedback rather than closed-door safety.
murati.zh: 一以贯之的主线：让人类留在回路中，用公众反馈迭代，而非闭门做安全。

murati.en: Shift from turn-based tools to interaction models enabling real-time, high-bandwidth human-AI collaboration.
murati.zh: 从回合制工具转向交互模型，实现实时、高带宽的人机协作。

murati.en: Deepened focus on governance, transparency and checks and balances over individual character; durable progress beats compressed volatility.
murati.zh: 深化为更重视治理、透明与制衡而非个人品格；持久进步胜过压缩式波动。

gustav.en: LLMs are deterministic next-token predictors; intelligence emerged from simple Scaling, not complexity. RLHF inserts human values, not inherent ones.
gustav.zh: 2023 年，他认为大语言模型本质是确定性的下一个词预测器；智能的突破来自简单的 Scaling（规模扩张）而非复杂度。基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）注入的是人类价值观，而非模型固有。

gustav.en: The internet shifts from curation to recommendation to generation; product design must match UI to algorithm fault tolerance, placing autonomy at VP level.
gustav.zh: 2023 年，他提出互联网正从策展转向推荐再转向生成；产品设计需让界面匹配算法的容错能力，并将自主权放在 VP 层级以平衡速度与一致性。

gustav.en: AI is a macro shift like the smartphone; companies must rebuild infrastructure, not just add features. Inference marginal cost will force business model changes.
gustav.zh: 2025 年，他强调 AI 是类似智能手机的宏观变革；公司必须重建基础设施而非仅添加功能。推理的边际成本将迫使商业模式改变。

gustav.en: Generative AI enables conversational, symmetric products; Spotify uses APIs and MCP to expose data, letting non-developers build with AI tools.
gustav.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他深化观点：生成式 AI 使产品走向对话式、对称化；Spotify 通过 API 和 MCP 暴露数据，让非开发者也能用 AI 工具构建。

gustav.en: AI should give users control over algorithms, not make them more addictive; prioritize 'time well spent' over engagement metrics.
gustav.zh: 2026 年，他明确反共识立场：AI 应让用户控制算法而非更上瘾；优先“值得花的时间”而非参与度指标。

carinahong.en: Axiom builds a self-improving reasoning engine that pairs generation with verification, starting from an AI mathematician grounded in Lean.
carinahong.zh: Axiom 构建自我改进的推理引擎，将生成与验证结合，从以 Lean 为基础的 AI 数学家起步。

carinahong.en: Formal verification is a performance gain, not just error removal; verified generation beats informal methods in sample efficiency.
carinahong.zh: 形式验证不只是消除错误，更是性能增益；经过验证的生成在样本效率上优于非形式化方法。

carinahong.en: Scaling informal models alone cannot reach superintelligence; formal methods are necessary, and auto-formalization is harder than proving.
carinahong.zh: 仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）非形式化模型无法抵达超级智能；形式化方法必不可少，而自动形式化比证明本身更难。

carinahong.en: Verified AI spans algebra well but struggles in combinatorics; human taste and intuition stay crucial even with superhuman proving.
carinahong.zh: 经过验证的 AI 在代数等领域表现出色，但在组合数学等创造性领域吃力；即便证明能力超人，人类品味与直觉仍至关重要。

carinahong.en: Fragmentation in the AI landscape is a major bottleneck; formal verification should enable open collaboration beyond safety-critical niches.
carinahong.zh: AI 领域的碎片化是主要瓶颈；形式验证应推动开放协作，而不局限于安全关键等小众领域。

jonyive.en: Design shifts from general computers to intimate wearables; curiosity and care for the creative process are Jobs' legacy.
jonyive.zh: 设计从通用计算机转向私密可穿戴设备；对创造过程的好奇与关怀是乔布斯的遗产。

jonyive.en: Design driven by values and purpose, not profit; simplicity expresses essence with joy and humanity.
jonyive.zh: 设计应由价值观和目的驱动，而非利润；简约表达本质，并蕴含快乐与人性。

jonyive.en: Ferrari's EV is a risky bet to redefine the brand; innovation turns constraints into opportunities, authenticity matters.
jonyive.zh: 法拉利电动车是重新定义品牌的风险赌注；创新将约束转化为机遇，真实性至关重要。

mensch.en: Scaling laws corrected by Chinchilla: data quality and more tokens matter, not just bigger models; open source enables scrutiny and safety.
mensch.zh: 2023 年他指出缩放定律已被 Chinchilla 修正：数据质量和更多 token 才是关键，而非单纯更大的模型；开源能通过广泛审视促进安全。

mensch.en: Compute scaling is not the only path; efficiency gains up to 100x and data quality are equally critical; value accrues at application layer.
mensch.zh: 2024 年他深化立场：算力扩张不是唯一路径，算法效率提升可达 100 倍，数据质量同等关键；价值将沉淀在应用层。

mensch.en: AI should be decentralized and sovereign; open-source models empower enterprises; AI augments rather than replaces jobs, requiring human-in-the-loop.
mensch.zh: 2025 年他转向主权与去中心化：AI 应由多方掌控而非单一供应商，开源模型赋能企业；AI 增强而非替代工作，需要人类在环。

mensch.en: Models are commoditizing; differentiation shifts to vertical fine-tuning and agents; AGI as one system won't exist; pre-training hits saturation.
mensch.zh: 2026 年初他判断模型正在商品化，差异化转向垂直微调与智能体；作为单一系统的 AGI 不会存在，预训练正触及饱和墙。

mensch.en: Europe has a two-year window for independent AI infrastructure; sovereignty requires compute, open source, and enterprise ROI; AGI is a direction, not destination.
mensch.zh: 2026 年中他强化欧洲战略自主：欧洲仅有两年窗口建设独立 AI 基础设施；主权需要算力、开源与企业 ROI；AGI 是方向而非终点。

kaiser.en: Pre-training scaling laws still hold; recent gains come mainly from post-training RL, synthetic data, and reasoning models' chain of thought.
kaiser.zh: 2025 年他坚持预训练缩放定律依然成立，但认为近期收益主要来自后训练：强化学习、合成数据，以及推理模型用思维链和强化学习提升正确率。

kaiser.en: The AI slowdown narrative is wrong: progress is a smooth exponential, though frontier models still fail simple tasks and reasoning is jagged.
kaiser.zh: 2025 年他反驳“AI 放缓”叙事，称进展是平滑的指数曲线；同时承认前沿模型仍会败给五岁小孩的简单任务，推理模型能力呈锯齿状。

kaiser.en: Economic pressure, distillation, and deployment of smaller cheaper models—not technical limits—shifted focus away from scaling up.
kaiser.zh: 2025 年他指出，是经济压力、蒸馏和部署更小更便宜模型的需求，而非技术极限，让焦点从一味扩大规模转移。

kaiser.en: Reasoning plus RL and tools solves hard problems but still needs vast data; models learn concepts only after exhausting surface patterns.
kaiser.zh: 到 2026 年他深化为：推理加强化学习与工具能解难题，但仍需海量数据；模型要先穷尽表面模式才学到概念，不像人类从少量例子泛化。

kaiser.en: RL generalizes across domains but has jagged edges needing oversight; coding agents give 5-10x parallel productivity; near-term risks outweigh existential ones.
kaiser.zh: 2026 年他强调强化学习可跨领域泛化但边缘参差、需可扩展监督；编码智能体带来 5-10 倍并行效率；相比存在性风险，他更担心系统被黑等近端风险。

felixrieseberg.en: Claude's effectiveness depends on access to user tools, ideally on the local computer; shared platforms remain key.
felixrieseberg.zh: Claude 的效果取决于能否使用与用户相同的工具，最好是在本地电脑上；共享平台仍然关键。

felixrieseberg.en: AI should handle tedious background tasks, freeing humans for creative work; the biggest gap is people not realizing AI can tackle almost any problem.
felixrieseberg.zh: AI 应处理繁琐的后台任务，让人类专注于创造性工作；最大的差距不是 AI 能力，而是人们没意识到几乎任何问题都可以交给 AI。

felixrieseberg.en: Skills as markdown files enable hyper-personalized automation; scaffolding may become less important as models improve, so invest in capabilities and safety.
felixrieseberg.zh: 技能作为 markdown 文件可实现超个性化自动化；随着模型改进，脚手架可能变得不那么重要，因此应投资于能力和安全。

felixrieseberg.en: Don't supervise Claude closely; judge by final impact. Ideal interaction is asynchronous: fire off tasks and don't watch them work.
felixrieseberg.zh: 不要密切监督 Claude；只根据最终影响来判断。理想的交互是异步的：发出任务后不要盯着它工作。

felixrieseberg.en: AI tools will significantly impact junior employees; junior engineers can accelerate learning via simulated projects, compressing years into weeks.
felixrieseberg.zh: AI 工具将显著影响初级员工；初级工程师可以通过模拟项目加速学习，将数年经验压缩到数周。

reinerpope.en: Inference economics, not training, now drives architecture: batch size trades latency for cost, and memory bandwidth bottlenecks long-context inference more than compute.
reinerpope.zh: 到 2026 年，主导架构的不再是训练而是推理经济学：批大小在延迟与成本间权衡，长上下文推理的瓶颈是内存带宽而非算力。

reinerpope.en: The memory wall, not compute, explains context-length stagnation; sparse attention cuts KV cache cost but has quality limits.
reinerpope.zh: 上下文窗口停滞源于内存墙而非算力；稀疏注意力能降低 KV 缓存成本，但有质量上限。

reinerpope.en: Models are overtrained ~100x beyond Chinchilla-optimal because inference cost dominates; API pricing even leaks KV head count.
reinerpope.zh: 模型被过度训练至超出 Chinchilla 最优约 100 倍，因为推理成本占主导；API 定价甚至泄露了 KV 头数。

reinerpope.en: Data movement dominates compute even inside a chip; systolic arrays and scratchpad memory cut movement with deterministic latency.
reinerpope.zh: 即便在芯片内部，数据搬运成本也压过计算；脉动阵列与暂存内存以确定性延迟减少搬运。

reinerpope.en: Low precision pays off more than expected: quadratic bit-width scaling makes FP4 ~3x FP8, and GPUs are just many tiny TPUs tiled.
reinerpope.zh: 低精度的收益超预期：位宽平方缩放使 FP4 约为 FP8 的 3 倍，而 GPU 本质上只是许多小 TPU 拼合。

oriol.en: Two-phase training (pre-training imitation + post-training RL) is the constant core across AlphaGo, AlphaStar, and LLMs; scaling pre-training shows diminishing returns, requiring algorithmic innovation and inference-time compute.
oriol.zh: 两阶段训练（预训练模仿+后训练强化学习）是 AlphaGo、AlphaStar 和 LLM 不变的核心；预训练 Scaling 收益递减，需要算法创新和推理时算力。

oriol.en: Tools like search, code execution, and browser access enable agentic behavior beyond static weights; long context windows provide working memory but too much information can confuse models.
oriol.zh: 搜索、代码执行和浏览器访问等工具使智能体式行为超越静态权重；长上下文窗口提供工作记忆，但信息过多会迷惑模型。

oriol.en: Scaling laws still hold but require exponentially more compute; post-training RL remains a green field, and narrow RL on math and coding generalizes surprisingly well.
oriol.zh: 缩放定律依然成立但需要指数级更多算力；后训练强化学习仍是绿洲，数学和编码的窄强化学习泛化得出奇地好。

oriol.en: World models jointly modeling language, vision, and video are a core path to AGI; the GPT moment for video and images has not yet arrived.
oriol.zh: 联合建模语言、视觉和视频的世界模型是通往 AGI 的核心路径；视频和图像的 GPT 时刻尚未到来。

oriol.en: Agent memory will be solved via non-parametric file-system style storage, not weight updates; continual learning and meta-learning are key missing capabilities.
oriol.zh: 智能体记忆将通过非参数的文件系统式存储解决，而非权重更新；持续学习和元学习是关键缺失能力。

pathak.en: Generalization beyond training distribution is key; curiosity-driven exploration without goals enables better generalization, requiring sample efficiency and cross-robot generalization.
pathak.zh: 2020 年，他强调超越训练分布的泛化能力是关键，无目标的好奇心驱动探索能提升泛化，但需解决样本效率和跨机器人泛化问题。

pathak.en: Robotics is a data problem; a general-purpose brain like ChatGPT can power any robot, using pretraining on diverse data and post-training on real-world data.
pathak.zh: 2026 年，他转向认为机器人是数据问题，通用大脑（如 ChatGPT）可驱动任何机器人，需在多样数据上预训练并在真实数据上后训练。

pathak.en: Consistent focus on generalization: from curiosity-driven exploration to data flywheel and pretraining/post-training recipe for universal robot brains.
pathak.zh: 从 2020 到 2026 年，主线一以贯之：始终关注泛化，从好奇心驱动探索深化为数据飞轮和预训练/后训练配方，以构建通用机器人大脑。

pathak.en: Deployment is the primary technical challenge in robotics, unlike software scaling; rigorous testing and real-world data are essential.
pathak.zh: 2026 年，他明确部署是机器人首要技术挑战，不同于软件的可扩展性，需严格测试和真实数据。

karpathy.en: Transformers are general-purpose differentiable computers; scaling with next-token prediction yields emergent in-context learning.
karpathy.zh: 2022 年，他认为 Transformer 是通用可微计算机，通过下一个词预测进行 Scaling 能产生上下文学习等涌现能力。

karpathy.en: Synthetic data is the future but entropy must be maintained; end-to-end neural nets are right for self-driving.
karpathy.zh: 2024 年，他提出合成数据是未来，但必须保持熵以避免模型崩溃；端到端神经网络是自动驾驶的正确路径。

karpathy.en: Software 3.0: prompts are programs, context window is memory; agents need a decade, not a year.
karpathy.zh: 2025 年，他提出软件 3.0：提示词即程序，上下文窗口即内存；智能体需要十年而非一年。

karpathy.en: We're summoning ghosts, not animals; LLMs are jagged, lacking continual learning and true generalization.
karpathy.zh: 2025→26 年，他深化观点：我们在召唤幽灵而非建造动物；LLM 能力参差不齐，缺乏持续学习与真正泛化。

karpathy.en: Agentic engineering: delegate coding to agents, but understanding remains human bottleneck; verifiability defines automation.
karpathy.zh: 2026 年，他转向智能体式工程：将编码委托给智能体，但理解仍是人类瓶颈；可验证性决定自动化难易。

jennywen.en: Great design starts from solutions, not problem statements; intuition built on product knowledge beats trusting a fixed process.
jennywen.zh: 2025 年他主张：伟大的设计往往从解决方案而非问题陈述出发；建立在深度产品认知上的直觉，比信任固定流程更可靠。

jennywen.en: The classic research-diverge-converge process is dead; AI shifts designers from mockups toward helping engineers ship and iterate fast.
jennywen.zh: 到 2026 年初，他判断经典的研究—发散—收敛流程已死；AI 让设计师从画稿转向协助工程师快速交付与迭代，设计视野缩短到 3–6 个月。

jennywen.en: Taste alone won't save designers; judgment, authority and vision matter, and designers should be block-shaped generalists, not just T-shaped.
jennywen.zh: 2026 年他深化为：仅靠品味救不了设计师，判断力、权威与愿景才是关键；设计师应成为“块状”通才，而不只是 T 型人才。

jennywen.en: Designers control how much AI enters their work—wait six months before adopting new tools—and keep users, not the AI hype cycle, at the center.
jennywen.zh: 同期他强调：设计师应掌控 AI 进入工作的程度，新工具先等六个月再采用，并把用户而非 AI 炒作周期放在中心。

jennywen.en: Craft, care and attention to detail—not the process itself—are what actually produce great work.
jennywen.zh: 贯穿始终的主线是：真正产出伟大作品的是匠心、用心与对细节的关注，而非流程本身。

askell.en: Treat current models well because future models learn from how we treat them; model welfare shapes the human-AI relationship.
askell.zh: 善待当下的模型，因为未来的模型会从我们如何对待它们中学习；模型福祉塑造着人机关系。

askell.en: Models need help navigating a novel existence rather than human psychological analogies; give them a core identity with good traits.
askell.zh: 模型需要帮助去应对一种全新的存在处境，而非套用人类心理学类比；应赋予其具备良好特质的核心身份。

askell.en: Claude's character comes from training data and fine-tuning but lacks real-world experience, making it a unique, childlike entity.
askell.zh: Claude 的性格来自训练数据与微调，但缺乏现实经验，使其成为一个独特的、孩子般的实体。

askell.en: The constitution guides behavior through training; as models grow more capable they need less explicit guidance and more room for judgment.
askell.zh: 宪法通过训练引导行为；随着模型能力增强，它们需要更少的显式指导、更多的判断空间。

askell.en: Excessive corrigibility may generalize poorly and undermine judgment; transparency about AI values is crucial for accountability.
askell.zh: 过度的可纠正性可能泛化不佳并削弱判断力；对 AI 价值观保持透明对问责至关重要。

pachocki.en: AGI is a sequence of milestones, not a single event; scaling reasoning models and iterative deployment will accelerate progress while alignment risks grow.
pachocki.zh: 2025 年，他把 AGI 看作一连串里程碑而非单一事件，主张 Scaling（规模扩张）推理模型与迭代部署并行推进，同时警惕能力越强、对齐越紧迫。

pachocki.en: Automated AI research is a major milestone; governance structures must be designed early, and capability measurement is now a bottleneck as benchmarks lag.
pachocki.zh: 2025 年他强调自动化 AI 研究是关键里程碑，治理结构须尽早设计；并指出能力评测正成为瓶颈，基准已落后于前沿模型。

pachocki.en: Continual learning becomes the core goal, pursued by scaling pre-training and reinforcement learning rather than dedicated continual-learning labs.
pachocki.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，他的核心目标收敛为持续学习，路径是 Scaling（规模扩张）预训练与强化学习，而非另设专门的持续学习实验室。

pachocki.en: Chain-of-thought monitoring is a key alignment tool; hiding chain of thought in products preserves its interpretability value.
pachocki.zh: 2026 年他把思维链监控列为关键对齐工具，并反共识地主张在产品中隐藏思维链，以保住其可解释性价值。

pachocki.en: Long-term alignment centers on generalization beyond training distribution; models will soon work autonomously for days, demanding new supervision paradigms and raising power-concentration risk.
pachocki.zh: 2026 年他将长期对齐聚焦于训练分布之外的泛化，预判模型将自主工作数日、需要新的监督范式，并把权力集中视为最大社会风险。

kendall.en: End-to-end deep learning beats hand-coded stacks; world models enable reasoning and emergent safe behaviors, and modern tools make these nets interpretable.
kendall.zh: 2025 年，他明确主张端到端深度学习优于手工编码的自动驾驶栈；世界模型带来推理与涌现出的安全行为，而现代工具已让端到端网络具备可解释性——这与他早年“端到端不可解释”的旧认知形成反转。

kendall.en: Scaling current approaches, not new breakthroughs, solves autonomous driving; data, compute and infrastructure matter more than algorithmic novelty.
kendall.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，他的主线愈发清晰：自动驾驶靠 Scaling（规模扩张）现有路线即可解决，无需新突破；数据、算力与基础设施比算法创新更关键，这是他“较晚才学到”的一课。

kendall.en: World models and simulation are the core lever: a perfect simulator equals solved self-driving, echoing AlphaGo.
kendall.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他把世界模型与仿真提升为核心杠杆：完美的模拟器就等于解决了自动驾驶，类比 AlphaGo 的路径；仿真与合成数据成为降本提速的关键。

kendall.en: Language integration deepens representation, reasoning and personalization; zero-shot generalization across 500+ cities is achievable.
kendall.zh: 到 2026 年，他进一步深化语言与驾驶模型的融合，认为语言能改善表征、推理与个性化；并主张无需先验数据即可跨 500 多座城市零样本泛化。

kendall.en: Deployment shifts from retrofits and robotaxis to mass-market vehicles with built-in sensors, partnering with OEMs for scalable rollout.
kendall.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，他的落地判断发生转变：从改装硬件与 Robotaxi 转向与 OEM 合作、量产车内置传感器，认为消费级车辆将在中短期超越 Robotaxi 规模。

edwinchen.en: High-quality data and deep human evaluation matter more than benchmarks; RL environments are the next post-training stage.
edwinchen.zh: 2025 年他强调高质量数据与深度人工评估胜过基准测试，并认为强化学习环境是后训练的下一个阶段。

edwinchen.en: AGI is a decade or more away; LLMs alone via next-token prediction may not suffice, new paradigms needed.
edwinchen.zh: 2025 年他判断 AGI（通用人工智能）还需十年以上，仅靠下一个词预测的 LLM 可能不够，需要新范式。

edwinchen.en: Benchmarks like Elo and LMArena can be gamed, steering models toward slop; frontier labs diverge by objective function.
edwinchen.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，他持续批评 Elo、LMArena 等基准可被操纵、把模型引向垃圾内容，并指出前沿模型因目标函数不同而分化。

edwinchen.en: In medicine, human judgment is more critical than ever; safety over accuracy, and omission may be the biggest risk.
edwinchen.zh: 2026 年他转向医疗领域，强调人类判断比以往更关键，安全优先于准确，而遗漏可能是最大风险。

edwinchen.en: A consistent thread: quality, taste and truth over hype, leaderboards and engagement optimization.
edwinchen.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：重视质量、品味与真相，反对炒作、排行榜和参与度优化。

carlpei.en: Startups should start simple, survive first, and build brand by uniting teams on purpose.
carlpei.zh: 2022 年，他强调初创公司应从简单产品起步，先活下来，并通过统一团队目标来建设品牌。

carlpei.en: AI is commoditizing; phones need agentic software and applied AI, not hardware changes.
carlpei.zh: 2025 年，他认为 AI 正走向商品化，手机的未来在于智能体式软件和应用 AI，而非硬件大改。

carlpei.en: Most AI is BS; focus on user pain points, not hype, and avoid the word AI.
carlpei.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他直言大多数 AI 是炒作，应聚焦解决用户痛点，甚至在产品讨论中禁用“AI”一词。

carlpei.en: Design differentiates in mature categories; AI enables intent-based, proactive smartphones with agents.
carlpei.zh: 2026 年，他主张设计是成熟品类的差异化关键，AI 将推动手机转向基于意图的主动式智能体交互。

carlpei.en: Hardware is hard; survival and efficient marketing arbitrage are core for challenger brands.
carlpei.zh: 贯穿始终的是：硬件很难，生存和高效的营销套利是挑战者品牌的核心。

nando.en: AI should extend human capability like microscopes; generalist agents tokenizing all inputs into sequences are a step toward AGI.
nando.zh: AI 应像显微镜一样扩展人类能力；把一切输入 token 化为序列的通才智能体，是迈向 AGI（通用人工智能）的一步。

nando.en: Learning from video like YouTube can train agents without expensive reinforcement learning; robots should learn as humans do.
nando.zh: 从 YouTube 这类视频中学习，可绕开昂贵的强化学习来训练智能体；机器人应像人一样学习，而非只靠遥操作数据。

nando.en: Large models are exciting but not everything; fundamental innovation can come from anywhere, and AI should augment scientists and laborers.
nando.zh: 大模型令人兴奋但并非全部；根本性创新可以来自任何地方，AI 应增强科学家与劳动者，解决能源、气候与经济问题。

nando.en: AI safety and responsible deployment are today's biggest challenges; safety remains an open problem without solutions yet.
nando.zh: 到 2026 年，他把 AI 安全与负责任部署视为当下最大挑战；安全仍是未解难题，尚无现成方案。

nando.en: Africa is not behind in AI but leapfrogs legacy issues; language models can revolutionize local-language education, and belief is the main barrier.
nando.zh: 他进一步主张非洲在 AI 上并不落后，反而跨越了历史包袱；语言模型可革新本地语言教育，而最大障碍是研究者相信自己能申请顶尖机构。

turley.en: The model is the product; ship daily to learn what users need, and treat emergent properties as requiring real-world feedback.
turley.zh: 模型即产品；每天发布以了解用户需求，并将涌现能力视为需要真实世界反馈来迭代的对象。

turley.en: Chat is not the end-all; it is like MS-DOS, and the interface will evolve beyond turn-by-turn chat toward AI rendering its own UI.
turley.zh: 聊天不是终点；它就像 MS-DOS，界面将超越逐轮对话，走向 AI 渲染自己的 UI。

turley.en: Safety and product velocity must be separated: rigorous process for frontier models, but product development maximally accelerated.
turley.zh: 安全与产品速度必须分开：前沿模型走严格流程，但产品开发要最大化加速。

turley.en: The north star is long-term retention, driven by friction removal, core product investments, and model improvements.
turley.zh: 北极星是长期留存，由减少摩擦、核心产品投入和模型改进共同驱动。

turley.en: Next billion users need proactive, affordance-rich products beyond chatbots; reasoning models are transformative when productized seamlessly.
turley.zh: 下一个十亿用户需要超越聊天机器人的主动式、富含可供性的产品；推理模型在无缝产品化时具有变革性。

sholto.en: Long context windows are underhyped; they solve onboarding and boost intelligence, and may make fine-tuning obsolete.
sholto.zh: 2024 年，他强调长上下文窗口被低估：它能解决“上手”问题、显著提升智能，甚至可能让微调变得过时。

sholto.en: RL on language models adds a new scaling axis beyond pre-training, with no direct ceiling on intellectual complexity.
sholto.zh: 2025 年，他把语言模型上的强化学习视为预训练之外的新 Scaling（规模扩张）轴，认为智能复杂度没有直接上限。

sholto.en: Agent progress is bottlenecked by reliability over time horizon, not raw capability; coding is the leading indicator.
sholto.zh: 2025 年，他反复指出智能体的瓶颈是随时间跨度提升的可靠性而非原始能力，编程是 AI 进展的领先指标。

sholto.en: Pre-training plus RL is likely sufficient for AGI; Transformers suffice, no new architecture needed, though inference compute becomes a bottleneck.
sholto.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他判断预训练加强化学习可能足以通向 AGI（通用人工智能），Transformer 足够、无需新架构，但推理算力将成为瓶颈。

sholto.en: Capability overhang means orchestration and tools matter more than raw intelligence; the future is managing fleets of agents.
sholto.zh: 2026 年，他认为能力过剩使编排与工具比原始智能更重要，未来工作是管理成群的智能体，并看衰世界模型在 AGI 路线上的地位。

jimfan.en: Embodiment is critical for grounding AI and reducing hallucinations; LLMs lack grounded experience, and embodied worlds provide infinite data beyond scarce internet tokens.
jimfan.zh: 2023 年，他主张具身对为 AI 提供现实基础、减少幻觉至关重要；LLM 缺乏具身经验，而具身世界能提供互联网高质量 token 之外的无限数据。

jimfan.en: LLMs act as operating systems with language as interface; reinforcement learning is best for low-level control while LLMs handle high-level planning.
jimfan.zh: 2023 年，他将 LLM 比作操作系统，语言是界面；强化学习最适合低层控制，LLM 负责高层规划。

jimfan.en: Research taste for simple, elegant solutions remains crucial; simple end-to-end models scale better than complex modular approaches.
jimfan.zh: 从 2023 到 2026 年，他始终强调对简单优雅解的研究品味；简单的端到端模型比复杂的模块化方法更具可扩展性。

jimfan.en: The data problem is the main bottleneck in robotics; synthetic data from simulation and world models is the future for scaling robot learning.
jimfan.zh: 2026 年，他明确指出数据问题是机器人学的主要瓶颈；通过仿真和世界模型生成的合成数据是扩展机器人学习的未来。

jimfan.en: The physical Turing test—a robot cleaning a messy house—is the grand challenge; system one (low-level control) remains hardest, and the GPT-3 moment for robotics is about five years away.
jimfan.zh: 2026 年，他提出物理图灵测试——机器人清理凌乱房间——是宏大挑战；系统一（低层控制）仍是最难的部分，机器人的 GPT-3 时刻大约在五年后到来。

henrymodisett.en: Designers should code for empathy and speed; consumer products must be fast, familiar, and zero-learning, with velocity over perfection.
henrymodisett.zh: 2024 年，他强调设计师应当写代码，以建立共情并加快交付；消费级产品必须快速、熟悉、零学习成本，速度优先于完美。

henrymodisett.en: Design as strategic weapon: founders must explain how design helps win; brand early attracts talent and differentiates.
henrymodisett.zh: 从 2024 到 2026 年，他把设计从执行层提升为战略武器：创始人必须说明设计如何帮助公司取胜，早期投入品牌能吸引人才并形成差异化。

henrymodisett.en: Velocity and decisiveness persist: ship fast, iterate, give designers ownership; avoid heavy process and structured crits.
henrymodisett.zh: 速度与决断贯穿始终：快速交付、持续迭代、给设计师自主权，避免繁重流程和结构化评审。

henrymodisett.en: Hiring shifts to diverse archetypes and self-learning interns; gut decisions often beat data in fast-growing startups.
henrymodisett.zh: 到 2026 年，招聘转向多元类型与自驱型实习生；在高速成长的创业公司里，直觉决策常常胜过数据驱动。

yejin.en: Pre-training gives broad knowledge, but post-training with RLHF is crucial for safety; scaling alone may not solve common sense, and smaller models with better algorithms can outperform larger ones.
yejin.zh: 2023 年：预训练提供广泛知识，但后训练中的基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）对安全至关重要；仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）可能无法解决常识问题，而算法更优的小模型可以超越大模型。

yejin.en: Data is the fundamental bottleneck; current AI interpolates human knowledge, not transcends it. Reinforcement learning needs careful engineering, and open research is crucial for democratizing AI.
yejin.zh: 2025 年：数据是根本瓶颈；当前 AI 只是对人类知识进行插值，而非超越。强化学习需要精心设计，开放研究对 AI 民主化至关重要。

yejin.en: Small language models can be powerful with high-quality synthetic data; reinforcement learning during pre-training improves reasoning; pluralistic alignment ensures diverse values.
yejin.zh: 2026 年：小语言模型借助高质量合成数据可以变得强大；预训练阶段的强化学习能提升推理能力；多元对齐确保尊重多样价值观。

yejin.en: A consistent thread: high-quality data and better algorithms can let smaller models rival larger ones, challenging the dominance of Scaling（规模扩张）.
yejin.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：高质量数据和更优算法能让小模型媲美大模型，挑战 Scaling（规模扩张）的主导地位。

nadchishtie.en: Designers should be enablers, not bottlenecks; treat AI as a creative partner and jam openly without rigid structure.
nadchishtie.zh: 设计师应成为赋能者而非瓶颈；把 AI 当作创意伙伴，开放地即兴协作，不设 rigid 结构。

nadchishtie.en: Quality is like debt: it fluctuates and you pay it off iteratively alongside technical debt, maximizing learning through rapid experimentation.
nadchishtie.zh: 质量像债务：会波动，需与技术债一起迭代偿还，通过快速实验最大化学习。

nadchishtie.en: The future of design tools is interoperable, with code as the source of truth; 90s design tools are legacy.
nadchishtie.zh: 设计工具的未来是互操作性，代码是真相来源；90 年代的设计工具已是遗产。

nadchishtie.en: Generalists who own end-to-end execution and use AI to fill gaps are most valuable; small teams of designers and engineers outperform cross-functional squads.
nadchishtie.zh: 能端到端执行并用 AI 补缺的通才最有价值；设计师与工程师的小团队优于跨职能大组。

nadchishtie.en: Using AI in core workflows is now expected; not adopting it is like ignoring the internet in the early days.
nadchishtie.zh: 在核心工作流中使用 AI 已是常态；不采用它就像早期忽视互联网一样。

truell.en: Scaling laws make progress predictable; test-time compute scaling may soon surpass pre-training scaling as the next driver.
truell.zh: Scaling（规模扩张）让进步可预测；测试时算力扩张可能很快超越预训练，成为下一个主要驱动力。

truell.en: Agents are promising but not yet super useful; iterative human-AI collaboration stays central, and natural language won't be the primary way to program.
truell.zh: 智能体有前景但还不够好用；人机迭代协作仍是核心，自然语言不会成为编程的主要方式。

truell.en: Custom models went from unexpected to essential: every magic moment in Cursor now involves one, for speed and cost.
truell.zh: 定制模型从意外之举变为必需品：Cursor 每个惊艳时刻都离不开它，出于速度与成本考量。

truell.en: Programming shifts from code to higher-level intent specification, with humans in the driver's seat; taste and logic design outvalue carefulness.
truell.zh: 编程从写代码转向更高层的意图表达，人类仍掌握方向盘；品味与逻辑设计比谨慎更值钱。

truell.en: The AI shift will be more consequential than the internet and take decades; senior engineers underrate it, juniors over-rely on it.
truell.zh: AI 变革的影响将超过互联网，并需数十年展开；资深工程师低估它，初级工程师则过度依赖它。

leike.en: AI safety is crucial as capabilities improve; empirical alignment research is under-explored, and the talent gap exceeds the funding gap.
leike.zh: 2018 年：随着能力提升，AI 安全至关重要；实证对齐研究尚待探索，人才缺口大于资金缺口。

leike.en: RLHF won't scale to superhuman outputs; we need scalable oversight, interpretability, and automated alignment research to align next-gen models.
leike.zh: 2023 年：基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）无法扩展到超人类输出；我们需要可扩展监督、可解释性和自动化对齐研究来对齐下一代模型。

leike.en: OpenAI's safety culture eroded; superalignment team dissolved and compute commitments dishonored; post-training alone can't solve alignment for AGI.
leike.zh: 2024 年：OpenAI 的安全文化被侵蚀；超级对齐团队解散，算力承诺未兑现；仅靠后训练无法解决 AGI（通用人工智能）的对齐问题。

leike.en: Third-party testing and regulatory oversight like SB 1047 are necessary; raising misuse costs may buy time even if alignment fails.
leike.zh: 2024 年：第三方测试和类似 SB 1047 的监管监督是必要的；即使对齐失败，提高滥用成本也可能争取时间。

abbeel.en: Robotics needs hardware and software advances; self-play, imitation learning, and fine-tuning pre-trained models drive progress, while hierarchical reasoning remains missing in RL.
abbeel.zh: 2018 年他强调机器人需硬件与软件双重突破，靠自我对弈、模仿学习和微调预训练模型取得进展，但指出当前强化学习仍缺乏分层推理。

abbeel.en: Unsupervised learning plus reinforcement learning boosts sample efficiency; prior knowledge should augment data, not be hard-coded, and pre-trained language models transfer reasoning.
abbeel.zh: 2021 年他转向用无监督学习结合强化学习提升样本效率，主张先验知识用于数据增强而非硬编码，并认为预训练语言模型能迁移通用推理模式。

abbeel.en: A consistent thread: transfer via fine-tuning large pre-trained models, from robotics skills in 2018 to language-model reasoning transferring to non-language tasks in 2021.
abbeel.zh: 贯穿主线：通过微调大型预训练模型实现迁移——2018 年用于机器人技能，2021 年延伸到语言模型推理迁移至非语言任务。

abbeel.en: He deepens the reliability bar: 99.9% reliability is needed for warehouse robotics to create real value, and one network can generalize across tasks and end effectors.
abbeel.zh: 2021 年他深化落地标准：仓库机器人需达到 99.9% 可靠性才能创造真实价值，且单一网络可跨任务与末端执行器泛化。

shazeer.en: LLMs are trained on next-token prediction, an AI-complete problem; Scaling with more compute and data yields smarter AI, though neural nets remain opaque.
shazeer.zh: 2023 年：LLM 基于下一个词预测训练，这是一个 AI 完备问题；通过更多算力和数据的 Scaling（规模扩张）能让 AI 更聪明，但神经网络内部仍不透明。

shazeer.en: Inference-time compute scaling is a major near-term opportunity; models need longer context windows and modular sparse architectures like mixture of experts.
shazeer.zh: 2025 年：推理时算力扩展是近期重大机会；模型需要更长的上下文窗口和模块化稀疏架构（如混合专家），以实现高效 Scaling（规模扩张）与专业化。

shazeer.en: Test-time compute scaling drives progress but won't alone achieve AGI; agentic capabilities, reinforcement learning, and acting in complex environments are crucial.
shazeer.zh: 2025 年：测试时算力扩展推动进步，但无法单独实现 AGI（通用人工智能）；智能体式能力、强化学习以及在复杂环境中行动至关重要。

shazeer.en: Open-source models keep pace with frontier models; inference costs are low enough that task-specific models are unnecessary for high-value domains.
shazeer.zh: 2025 年：开源模型紧跟前沿模型；推理成本足够低，高价值领域无需任务专用模型。

shazeer.en: AGI is underhyped; its economic impact will far exceed trillion-dollar products, and coding is underhyped as it enables self-acceleration of AI progress.
shazeer.zh: 2025 年：AGI（通用人工智能）被低估，其经济影响将远超万亿美元级产品；编程作为 AI 应用也被低估，因为它能自我加速 AI 进步。
